title: 机器学习工程师
workMode: 待确认
description:
岗位介绍：
我们正在招聘机器学习工程师，负责构建搜索、推荐和多模态检索系统背后的核心智能能力。

这是一个具有高影响力、强调实践的岗位，适合希望将机器学习、深度学习和生成式 AI 应用于大规模真实产品问题的工程师。你将参与检索、排序、相关性、内容理解、Embedding 和多模态模型相关工作，并将研究思路转化为能够改善用户体验和业务指标的生产系统。

核心职责：
• 构建并部署用于搜索、推荐和内容发现的机器学习模型。
• 改进文本、图像、视频和结构化数据的多模态检索能力。
• 针对实际生产场景开发和微调大语言模型及视觉语言模型。
• 解决查询理解、召回、排序、Embedding 和 RAG 等相关性问题。
• 设计实验、分析结果，并推动关键业务指标获得可衡量的提升。
• 处理大规模数据，构建实用且具备可扩展性的机器学习系统。

任职要求：
• 具备将机器学习应用于搜索、推荐、广告、Feed 排序或相关性优化的扎实经验。
• 具备机器学习、深度学习、自然语言处理或多模态学习方面的扎实基础。
• 有检索、排序、Embedding、相关性优化或 RAG 的实践经验。
• 有多模态模型经验者优先。
• 熟悉 SFT、LoRA、PEFT、RLHF 或 DPO 等大模型微调方法者优先。
• 具备扎实的 Python、Go 或 C++ 编程能力。
• 能够适应快速变化、强调自主负责的创业团队环境。
descriptionEn:
About the Role:
We are hiring Machine Learning Engineers to build the core intelligence behind our search, recommendation, and multimodal retrieval systems.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for engineers who want to apply machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI to real product problems at scale. You will work on retrieval, ranking, relevance, content understanding, embeddings, and multimodal models, and help turn research ideas into production systems that improve user experience and business metrics.

Responsibilities:
• Build and deploy ML models for search, recommendation, and discovery.
• Improve multimodal retrieval across text, image, video, and structured data.
• Develop and fine-tune LLMs and vision-language models for production use cases.
• Work on relevance problems including query understanding, recall, ranking, embeddings, and RAG.
• Run experiments, analyze results, and drive measurable improvements in KPIs.
• Process large-scale data and build practical, scalable ML systems.

Requirements:
• Strong experience in machine learning applied to search, recommendation, ads, feed ranking, or relevance.
• Strong fundamentals in ML, deep learning, NLP, or multimodal learning.
• Hands-on experience with retrieval, ranking, embeddings, relevance optimization, or RAG.
• Experience with multimodal models is strongly preferred.
• Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning methods such as SFT, LoRA, PEFT, RLHF, or DPO is a plus.
• Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or C++.
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-ownership startup environment.

title: 数据合作经理
workMode: on-site
description:
岗位概述：我们正在寻找一位热情且执行力强的供应链BD负责人，负责拓展具身机器人数据采集场景和众包运营。您将参与构建和运营具身机器人数据采集的众包供应链模型，拓展现实场景中的数据采集机会，确保为具身AI模型训练提供高质量的多模态数据。

核心职责：
• 场景拓展与供应链生态建设：协助规划和执行具身机器人数据采集场景的拓展，深入一线发掘工厂、家庭、零售、医疗、物流等现实环境中的数据采集机会。参与构建和运营数据采集众包模式，协助管理多元化的数据采集员供应链。
• 众包平台与数据流程管理：负责整个数据采集流程的日常运营，包括任务创建、采集执行、初筛和数据交付。与产品和技术团队合作，提供众包采集工具的用户体验反馈，推动工具迭代优化。
• 运营赋能与规模化增长：协助制定覆盖更多地区和场景的规模化策略，提高数据网络的密度和产能。
• 团队与供应商管理：负责日常构建、培训和管理小型数据运营团队，管理外部众包采集员和第三方数据服务供应商。

岗位要求：
• 本科及以上学历，计算机科学、通信、自动化、数据科学、管理等相关专业优先。
• 3年以上供应链、BD、运营、项目管理或数据管理经验，至少1年团队管理经验。
• 具备众包模式、共享经济或大规模本地推广活动执行经验。
• 具备场景拓展意识和供应链思维。
• 优秀的英语书面和口头沟通能力。
descriptionEn:
Job Overview: We are seeking a passionate and execution-driven Supply Chain BD leader to spearhead data collection scenario expansion and crowdsourced operations for embodied robotics. You will participate in building and operating a crowdsourcing supply chain model for embodied robot data collection, expanding data acquisition opportunities in real-world scenarios, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality, multimodal data for embodied AI model training.

Core Responsibilities:
- Scenario Expansion & Supply Chain Ecosystem Building: Assist in planning and executing the expansion of data collection scenarios for embodied robots, going deep into the frontline to uncover data collection opportunities in real-world environments such as factories, households, retail, healthcare, and logistics.
- Crowdsourcing Platform & Data Pipeline Management: Take charge of the day-to-day operations of the entire data collection workflow. Collaborate with product and technical teams to drive iterative optimization of crowdsourced collection tools.
- Operational Empowerment & Scaled Growth: Assist in formulating scaling strategies to cover more regions and scenarios, increasing the density and production capacity of the data network.
- Team & Vendor Management: Responsible for building, training, and managing a small data operations team. Manage and coordinate external crowdsourced collectors and third-party data service vendors.

Job Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Communications, Automation, Data Science, Management, or related fields.
- 3+ years of experience in supply chain, BD, operations, project management, or data management, including at least 1 year of team management experience.
- Hands-on experience in crowdsourcing models, the sharing economy, or managing large-scale localized rollouts.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

title: 技术项目经理
workMode: 待确认
description:
我们的使命：
MaxInsights 通过端到端数据解决方案平台，帮助机器人基础模型公司获取大规模、高质量且可扩展的具身智能训练数据。前沿实验室正在竞相构建通用机器人，而高质量训练数据是当前的核心瓶颈。我们正在建设数据采集系统、仿真引擎、运营能力及软件工具链，帮助合作伙伴持续推动行业发展。

工作职责：
• 端到端项目交付：负责复杂机器人数据采集与标注项目的完整生命周期，从前期客户需求对齐、方案设计到最终交付。确保数据集生产满足客户严格的 SLA 和准确率标准，同时管理内部成本及进度目标。
• 数据解决方案与规范设计：深入理解客户的机器人模型训练需求，包括传感器、数据模态和动作空间。将模糊的学术及商业需求转化为具体、高精度的数据采集、仿真和标注规范。
• 全球跨职能协调：担任项目的核心协调枢纽，连接美国、中国和东南亚团队，协同工程、数据运营、算法及全球标注团队，推动跨时区的顺畅执行。
• 质量控制与进度监控：搭建并监控数据生产管线的实时追踪系统。
descriptionEn:
Our Mission:
At MaxInsights, we enable Robotics Foundation Model companies to access massive, high-quality, scalable training data for embodied AI through our end-to-end data solution platform. Frontier labs are racing to build general-purpose robots, and high-quality training data is the bottleneck. We are building the data collection systems, simulation engines, operational capabilities, and software toolchain to help our partners drive the field forward.

What You'll Do:
• End-to-End Project Delivery: Own the full lifecycle of complex robotics data collection and annotation projects—from initial client alignment and solution design to final delivery. Ensure dataset production meets strict client SLAs and accuracy standards while managing internal cost and timeline targets.
• Data Solution & Spec Design: Deeply understand clients' robotic model training needs, including sensors, modalities, and action spaces. Translate ambiguous academic and commercial requirements into concrete, high-precision data collection, simulation, and annotation specifications.
• Global Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the central program hub coordinating teams across the US, China, and Southeast Asia. Bring together engineering, data operations, algorithms, and global annotation teams to drive seamless execution across time zones.
• Quality Control & Progress Monitoring: Build and monitor real-time tracking systems for data production pipelines.

title: SMB Account Executive

title: 社区增长与本地用户运营

description:

• 3 年以上社区增长、社区运营、本地用户运营、大使计划或消费级增长经验。
• 有搭建高活跃用户社群、城市大使或核心用户体系的实际经验。

descriptionEn:
About the Role:
Join an AI-powered local discovery team and help build its early local user network and ambassador ecosystem, starting in the SF Bay Area. This is not a traditional moderation role: you will grow a consumer product through authentic relationships, online engagement, offline activations, and scalable community systems.

What You'll Do:
• Build and grow the early local user community across the SF Bay Area, identifying engaged users, early adopters, contributors, and local ambassadors.
• Create meaningful engagement around food, travel, lifestyle, and city exploration, and nurture relationships with core members and local tastemakers.
• Operate online community spaces and design onboarding, participation, and feedback loops for power users and contributors.
• Plan and execute local meetups, city-based activations, and ambassador-led experiences.
• Build repeatable playbooks for ambassador programs, local activations, onboarding, and community engagement to support future city expansion.
• Gather user sentiment and product insights and connect them with Product and Growth teams.

What We're Looking For:
• 3+ years in community growth, community operations, local engagement, ambassador programs, or consumer growth.
• Experience building highly engaged user communities, ambassador networks, or power-user ecosystems.
• Ability to plan both online and offline community experiences, with strong communication, relationship-building, and execution skills.
• An operational mindset and the ability to turn field learning into repeatable systems and playbooks.
• Strong interest in local discovery, food, travel, lifestyle, or social consumer products, and comfort in an early-stage startup.

Nice to Have: local discovery, consumer social, marketplace, or lifestyle-product experience; familiarity with Discord, Geneva, Partiful, or Luma; UGC or community-led growth experience; local creator relationships; or familiarity with AI-powered consumer and recommendation products.

- 具有海外营销、品牌传播、创作者增长、商务拓展或合作伙伴关系经验

descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
We are looking for a passionate Global Marketing Designer who loves design and is curious about the AI industry to join OiiOii AI's overseas marketing team. You will be responsible for the visual design of OiiOii's overseas marketing, including but not limited to the production and iteration of advertising creatives for platforms such as Google, Meta, TikTok, X, etc.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Responsible for the visual design of OiiOii AI's overseas marketing, including but not limited to the production and iteration of advertising creatives for platforms such as Google, Meta, TikTok, X, etc.
2. Design marketing creatives that meet local aesthetics based on the user characteristics of different markets (such as Europe, the United States, Japan, etc.), and continuously optimize the click-through rate (CTR) and conversion effectiveness of advertisements.
3. Responsible for visual design related to online marketing activities, including social media promotional images, product promotional creatives, official website banners, EDMs, landing pages, etc.
4. Responsible for the design of materials for offline exhibitions and brand events, including brand creatives such as booth visuals, roll-up banners, posters, brochures, merchandise, gift packaging, etc.
5. Collaborate closely with overseas teams, respond quickly to business needs, combine overseas design trends and AI industry dynamics, continuously produce high-quality marketing creatives and visual solutions, and enhance brand influence and marketing effectiveness.

Job Requirements:
1. Bachelor's degree or above, with majors in visual communication, graphic design, or other related fields preferred; 1 year or more of relevant work experience in marketing design, graphic design, or visual design, and those with experience in the internet, AI, or overseas expansion industries preferred.
2. Proficient in using design tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Premiere Pro, After Effects, etc., and able to independently complete marketing visual design and video editing tasks.
3. Has good aesthetic ability, a strong understanding of the design styles and marketing visuals of overseas internet products, experience in advertising creative design, and is familiar with the optimization logic of advertising creatives and user click psychology.
4. Possesses good communication skills, teamwork abilities, and execution capabilities, can adapt to the fast-paced iterative work rhythm, and complete design tasks on time with high quality.
5. Please attach your personal portfolio when submitting your resume.

Bonus Points:
1. Has experience in AI products, SaaS, and internet companies expanding overseas, and is familiar with the design of overseas advertising creatives such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads.
2. Familiar with the aesthetics and marketing design styles of users in overseas markets such as Europe, the United States, and Japan, and has relevant design experience in overseas brands or growth marketing.
3. Familiar with AI models and tools such as Midjourney, Nano Banana, GPT Image, and Seedream, and able to apply them to design efficiency improvement and creative content production.

We hope you have:
1. Passionate about design and full of curiosity about the AI industry.
2. Good at learning and willing to try new design styles and AI tools.
3. Pays attention to details and has high requirements for the quality of works.
4. Have marketing thinking, not only focusing on "whether the design is good-looking", but also on "whether it can drive growth and conversion".

descriptionEn:

We are building the next generation of global creator communities. We are looking for a Creator Growth & Community Manager who can drive creator acquisition, activation, and retention through scalable community programs, growth initiatives, and high-impact creator experiences.

This is not a traditional events role. We are looking for someone who sees community as a growth engine and can turn creator relationships, community programs, and local initiatives into scalable organic growth. You will play a key role in shaping how creators discover, engage with, and grow within the global community.

What You Will Do:
• Lead creator growth initiatives across key international markets, driving creator acquisition, engagement, and long-term retention.
• Design and execute scalable community programs, including creator meetups, ambassador programs, campus programs, creator summits, and referral initiatives.
• Build and nurture relationships with creators across different verticals, helping them succeed and grow within the community.

• 面向北美及全球用户优化产品体验，包括启动速度、流畅度、包体积及弱网性能。
• 推动海外差异化功能从 0 到 1 落地，包括本地化交互、多语言适配及隐私、未成年人保护等区域合规能力。
• 与产品、设计、后端及算法团队紧密协作，快速迭代并保障线上质量；参与代码评审与技术方案设计。
• 建设和完善客户端基础设施，包括稳定性监控、性能追踪、A/B 实验框架及 CI/CD 流程。
• 探索 AI 辅助研发与端上智能场景的落地。

任职要求：
• 计算机相关专业本科及以上学历，3 年以上 iOS 开发经验。
• 精通 Swift/Objective-C，熟悉 UIKit/SwiftUI、内存管理与性能调优。
• 有百万级以上 DAU 大型 App 的开发及线上问题处理经验，理解组件化、模块化及跨端等客户端架构设计。
• 具备扎实的计算机基础，包括数据结构、算法、网络和操作系统。
• 中英文可作为工作语言，能够与跨时区团队高效协作。

加分项：
• 有社区、社交或内容类产品经验，理解 UGC 产品的客户端技术特点。
• 有全球化产品经验，熟悉多语言、多时区及 GDPR、CCPA、COPPA 等隐私合规适配。
• 有 Flutter、React Native 跨端经验或动态化框架建设经验。
• 有音视频、图像处理或端智能方向积累。
• 有活跃的开源贡献或技术写作经验。
descriptionEn:
About the Team:
This is a fast-growing global lifestyle content community platform building a client engineering team for international markets. The team crafts high-quality mobile experiences for users worldwide and collaborates across the United States, Singapore, and Asia.

Responsibilities:
• Design, build, and maintain core iOS modules covering content consumption, content creation, and creator tools.
• Optimize the experience for North American and global users, including launch time, smoothness, binary size, and weak-network performance.
• Drive 0-to-1 development of market-specific features, including localized interactions, multi-language support, privacy, minor protection, and other regional compliance capabilities.
• Partner closely with product, design, backend, and algorithm teams to iterate quickly while maintaining production quality; participate in code reviews and technical design.
• Strengthen client infrastructure, including stability monitoring, performance tracing, A/B experimentation, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Explore AI-assisted development workflows and on-device intelligence.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or a related field, with 3+ years of iOS development experience.
• Proficiency in Swift/Objective-C and solid knowledge of UIKit/SwiftUI, memory management, and performance tuning.
• Experience shipping and operating large-scale apps with 1M+ DAU and a strong understanding of modularization, componentization, and cross-platform client architecture.
• Solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, networking, and operating systems.
• Ability to work effectively in both English and Chinese across time zones.

Nice to Have:
• Experience with community, social, or content products and an understanding of UGC-specific client challenges.
• Experience with global products, multi-language and multi-time-zone support, and privacy compliance such as GDPR, CCPA, and COPPA.
• Flutter, React Native, or dynamic framework development experience.
• Background in audio/video, image processing, or on-device machine learning.
• Active open-source contributions or technical writing.

workModeEn: Hybrid, 3+ days per week in office
description:
关于团队：
这是一家拥有超过 4 亿用户的全球内容与生活方式社区平台。平台以真实的人类经验和用户分享为核心，正处于全球化发展的重要阶段。

岗位介绍：
战略与运营负责人将连接公司高层愿景与日常执行。我们寻找一位系统性思考者，为社区、市场及创意团队推动战略路线图和运营目标，诊断组织瓶颈，并设计可规模化的流程以实现可衡量的增长。

核心职责：
• 推动年度及季度业务规划，将高层愿景转化为务实的运营路线图。
• 依据公司长期使命，为业务团队设计职能目标及可衡量的 KPI。
• 开发 KPI 追踪工具与模型，将原始数据转化为面向管理团队的叙事性洞察，并主动推动 AI 在组织中的应用。
• 与财务团队协作主导年度及补充预算流程，确保资源投入到高回报且符合季度目标的项目。
• 牵头跨团队协作，部署可规模化的系统以提升组织效率。
• 识别现有工作流中的低效环节，通过自动化或流程精简提升团队速度与产出。
• 管理外部合作机构的关系、工作流和交付。
• 领导业务变革项目，协调跨团队利益相关方，推动新运营标准的高采用率。

任职要求：
• 6–10 年以上战略、业务运营或相关经验；有市场、品牌、GTM 或咨询经验者优先。
• 能够处理缺乏既有方法论的问题，将复杂方向转化为清晰策略和可执行目标。
• 能将战略路线图转化为简洁文档，并面向不同受众有效沟通。
• 热衷于建设和扩张创始团队及其文化，有相关经验者优先。
• 能在没有直接汇报关系的情况下推动跨团队协作，并影响高管和合作伙伴。
• 具备跨文化同理心和成熟度，能够连接多元文化背景的全球团队。
• 能通过数据洞察识别差距与机会，并主动推动 AI 在组织中的应用。
• 具备项目管理和变革管理能力。
• 具有创业者思维和建设者精神，真正享受快速的 0 到 1 环境。

薪酬与福利：
• 总薪酬最高可谈至 80 万美元，实际方案将严格依据候选人的岗位级别、资历、技能和经验确定。
• 具有竞争力的限制性股票、年度绩效奖金和综合福利。
• 每年17天带薪休假及10天带薪病假。
• 根据州法律提供育儿假。
• Cigna 医疗、牙科和视力保险，公司承担员工100%的保费。
• 提供含雇主匹配的 401(k) 退休计划。
• 可自愿选择定期寿险、意外险、伤残险、重大疾病险和住院津贴险。
descriptionEn:
About the Team:
This is a global content and lifestyle community platform trusted by more than 400 million users. Built around real human experience and authentic sharing, the platform is now entering an important stage of international growth.

About the Role:
The Strategy & Operations Leader will serve as the connective tissue between high-level vision and daily execution. This role is best suited for a systems thinker who can drive strategic roadmaps and operational goals for Community, Marketing, and Creative teams, diagnose organizational bottlenecks, and design scalable processes that produce measurable growth.

Core Responsibilities:
• Drive annual and quarterly business planning, translating high-level vision into a pragmatic operational roadmap.
• Design functional goals and measurable KPIs for business teams in alignment with the company's long-term mission.
• Develop tools and models to track KPIs, translate raw data into narrative insights for the executive team, and proactively drive AI adoption across the organization.
• Lead annual and supplemental budgeting with Finance, ensuring capital is deployed toward high-ROI initiatives aligned with quarterly goals.
• Lead cross-functional orchestration and deploy scalable systems that improve organizational efficiency and collaboration.
• Identify inefficiencies in current workflows and implement automated or streamlined systems to improve team velocity and output.
• Manage relationships, workflows, and delivery with external partner agencies.
• Lead business change initiatives across stakeholders and drive adoption of new operational standards.

Qualifications:
• 6–10+ years of experience in strategy, business operations, or a relevant field; marketing, branding, GTM, or consulting experience is preferred.
• Exceptional ability to solve problems without an existing playbook and turn complex directions into clear strategies and actionable goals.
• Ability to translate strategic roadmaps into concise documentation and communication for diverse audiences.
• Passion for building and scaling a founding team and its culture; relevant experience is a plus.
• Ability to lead cross-functional collaboration and influence senior executives and partners without direct authority.
• Strong empathy and maturity in bridging cultural backgrounds within a truly global and diverse team.
• Ability to identify gaps and opportunities through data-driven insights and proactively drive AI applications.
• Confidence in project management and change management.
• An entrepreneurial mindset and builder mentality, with genuine excitement for a fast-paced 0-to-1 environment.

Compensation and Benefits:
• Total compensation may be discussed up to $800,000, with the final package strictly calibrated to the candidate's level, qualifications, skills, and experience.
• Competitive equity package, annual performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits.
• 17 days of PTO and 10 days of paid sick leave per year.
• Parental leave in accordance with applicable state law.
• Comprehensive Cigna medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee premiums covered by the company.
• 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching.
• Optional supplemental term life, accidental, disability, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance.

This is a founding growth leadership seat with direct ownership of 0-to-1 global growth and commercialization for an AI-native product. You will build the international growth system, personally manage paid-media budgets, validate channels, improve conversion, and shape product and GTM direction with the founders and product team.

Responsibilities:
• Define global user-growth strategy, goals, and milestone roadmaps as the founding growth leader.
• Own the full 0-to-1 international growth journey across paid acquisition, content, creative iteration, channels, conversion, and monetization.
• Personally manage and scale advertising budgets while delivering sustainable growth against CAC, ROI, ROAS, LTV, retention, and payment targets.
• Build the analytics foundation for attribution, funnel monitoring, experimentation, performance reviews, and growth modeling.
• Translate frontline insight from advertising and seller-growth scenarios into product definition and agent-capability improvements.
• Build and lead a high-execution global growth team across Product, Algorithms, Engineering, and Creative.
• Explore AI-native workflows for insight, creative generation, media optimization, and commercialization.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree or above; overseas study or work experience is preferred.
• 3+ years of full-funnel international growth experience with verifiable 0-to-1 and scaled-growth outcomes.
• Hands-on ownership of international paid-media budgets and strong command of acquisition, creative testing, conversion, attribution, and performance analysis.
• Ability to independently build a growth system and solve core growth problems rather than only manage agencies.
• Data-driven product judgment and an understanding of how growth and monetization reinforce each other.
• Exploratory, open, highly engaged with AI, and accountable for results amid uncertainty.
• Professional working English and confidence in cross-cultural business collaboration.

Nice to Have: AI, AdTech, SaaS, e-commerce, or creator-tool growth experience; ownership of significant media budgets or global GTM; and early-stage, Founding Growth, or VP Growth experience.

What We Offer: a core founding seat with real decision-making influence, competitive cash compensation and project equity, and the opportunity to build a global AI-native product from zero with experienced repeat founders.

description:

descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Serve as the project engineering owner for the company's core Multi-Agent product, taking it from 0 to 1 through launch and continuous iteration while helping the founders explore AI-native product and organizational models.

Responsibilities:
• Own full-stack architecture, development, deployment, launch, and iteration for the core Multi-Agent product.
• Co-define AI-native product experiences with Product and continuously improve usability.
• Build core agent capabilities including orchestration, tool use, context management, memory, permissions, human-in-the-loop controls, and failure recovery.
• Use Codex, Claude Code, and other AI coding tools to accelerate delivery and establish AI-native engineering practices.
• Help shape engineering processes, collaboration models, automation, and the broader AI-native organization.
• Establish strong engineering foundations across Git workflows, CI/CD, observability, security, and rollback.

Qualifications:
• Roughly 3–7 years of software-development experience and ownership of at least one complete commercial or independent product from development through launch and iteration.
• Frontend or backend roots are both welcome, but you must have genuine full-stack capability and independently deliver and deploy products.
• Strong proficiency with Codex, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding tools, with at least one independently delivered AI-assisted project.
• Proficiency in at least one backend stack among Node.js, Python, Go, or Java, and one frontend framework among React, Next.js, or Vue.
• Familiarity with RESTful APIs plus common communication patterns such as GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE, and asynchronous queues.
• Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis and sound judgment around indexing, transactions, modeling, and performance.
• Understanding of agent architecture, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, function/tool calling, streaming, and structured outputs.
• Experience with at least one cloud or deployment platform plus Git, CI/CD, environment management, observability, and basic security.
• Exploratory, open, comfortable with 0-to-1 ambiguity, and able to work in English.

Nice to Have: open-source or independent projects; startup, early-team, tech-lead, or indie-hacker experience; OpenClaw, MCP, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Dify, n8n, or Flowise; mobile/desktop development; RAG, plugin systems, workflow orchestration, scheduling, or permissions.

What You Get: a core 0-to-1 product seat with meaningful decision influence, salary plus project equity, an efficient AI-native team led by repeat founders, and hands-on exposure to Multi-Agent systems, AI coding, MCP, and AI-native organization design.

description:
关于公司：
Vord AI 是一款隐私优先的 AI 对话产品。用户可以通过统一界面使用 Claude、GPT、Gemini 与开放权重模型，而模型提供方及 Vord 自身都无法读取用户输入内容。与在服务器端解密提示词、再承诺不记录的常见方案不同，Vord 只基于元数据完成路由，基础设施不接触对话内容，隐私保证建立在架构而非政策承诺之上。

公司服务那些对工作对话、法律与医疗问题及尚未成形的想法流向何处感到不安，却不会阅读技术白皮书的用户。产品不仅要比主流工具更私密，也必须同样好用。团队规模小、处于早期阶段，这是公司第一位专职商业增长成员，直接向创始人汇报。

岗位介绍：
这是一个 0→1 的 Founding Growth 岗位。你将端到端负责用户获取、激活、留存、商业化与分发，找到首批可规模化的获客渠道，并搭建将早期用户转化为长期客户的增长系统。这是高度亲自执行的岗位，而非纯管理岗位；在可预见阶段，你就是增长团队，并可按需协调顾问、自由职业者与代理机构。

前六个月的核心职责：
• 探索并验证真正有效的获客方式，在内容与 SEO、社区、合作伙伴、嵌入式分发、创作者及付费渠道中快速实验，规模化有效渠道并果断停止无法回本的投入。
• 建立符合隐私架构的增长度量体系，使用增量性测试、地理对照组和轻量模型衡量效果，而不是依赖完整的监控式广告与像素归因体系。
• 优化从注册到首次获得真实产品价值的激活路径，与工程团队共同解决用户首次有效对话前的流失问题。
• 对留存曲线负责，超越单纯的模型聚合价值，寻找并建设促使用户长期回访的核心机制。
• 至少落地一项分发合作，包括捆绑、嵌入或产品集成；通过高质量合作创造优于单纯竞价流量的增长。
• 为数据泄露、政策变化及行业事件带来的隐私需求峰值提前准备，建立媒体关系、可快速发布的内容与响应机制。
• 以单位经济学管理增长。公司转售模型推理能力，需严格关注毛利、CAC 回收周期、付费转化与长期用户价值。

任职要求：
• 曾将消费级或专业用户订阅产品从接近零推进至真实规模，能够坦诚分析留存曲线、增长瓶颈、失败实验与复盘结论。
• 有在归因失灵环境中操盘增长的经验，例如 ATT 或 iOS 14.5 之后的移动端与 DTC，并能独立设计可靠的增量性测试。
• 具备优秀的写作与信息转译能力，能把复杂隐私架构讲给不具备技术背景的专业用户听，并形成有传播力的市场表达。
• 做过 BD、产品嵌入、捆绑或集成等合作分发，而不只是广告竞价与付费投放。
• 能理解产品技术架构并准确对外表达，能够识别超出技术事实或证据范围的营销主张。
• 具备扎实的单位经济学意识，能够围绕毛利、CAC、回收周期、LTV 和订阅收入作出增长决策。

加分项：
• 有隐私、安全或其他以信任为核心的产品经验。
• 自带相关行业受众或内容影响力。
• 有跨多个地区开展增长工作的经验。

不太适合本岗位的情况：
• 只希望在现成漏斗上扩大付费投放，而不愿从零搭建完整增长系统。
• 主要经验集中在手游或 App 安装买量，缺少高决策成本、信任驱动型产品经验。
• 希望先组建团队、再亲自参与执行。
• 必须依赖完整且干净的归因数据才能作出判断。

办公与回报：
• 全职远程，无固定办公室；团队每年约有两个月线下集中办公，过往地点包括首尔和上海，具体日期待确认。
• 优先考虑亚太地区候选人，同时也考虑美国候选人。
• 提供有竞争力的薪酬与具有实际意义的股权激励。
• 直接向创始人汇报。

如何申请：
请联系 Goldy，并提供以下两项材料：
1. 一段你亲自推动过的增长案例，包括渠道组合、留存曲线，以及如果重新开始会如何调整。
2. 用 200 字向一位从未思考过 AI 输入去向的 45 岁会计解释 Vord AI。不要使用行话，重点体现你对用户真正关心事项的判断。

第二项是核心考察内容，团队会优先阅读。不需要传统求职信，也不会仅按履历背景筛选，更关注你真正做成过什么。
descriptionEn:
About Vord:
Vord AI is a privacy-first AI chat product. It gives people access to Claude, GPT, Gemini, and open-weight models through one interface, while neither the model provider nor Vord itself can read what users write. Unlike products that decrypt prompts on their own servers and promise not to log them, Vord routes on metadata only. Its infrastructure never sees prompt contents, so the privacy guarantee rests on architecture rather than a policy page.

The product is for people who are quietly uneasy about where their work conversations, legal and medical questions, and half-formed ideas are going, but who will never read a whitepaper. It must be as good to use as mainstream tools, not merely more private. The team is small and early-stage. This is the first dedicated commercial hire and reports directly to the Founder.

The Role:
This is a 0-to-1 founding growth role owning the full loop: Acquisition → Activation → Retention → Monetization → Distribution. You will find the first scalable acquisition channels and build the systems that turn early users into long-term customers. This is a hands-on operating role, not a management position. For the foreseeable future, you are the growth team, supported by contractors and agencies where useful.

What You Will Own in the First Six Months:
• Find the acquisition motion that works. Test content and SEO, communities, partnerships, embeds, creators, and paid channels where they earn their place; scale what pays back and cut what does not.
• Build measurement that fits the privacy architecture. Use incrementality tests, geo holdouts, and lightweight modelling instead of relying on a surveillance-ad stack or pixel-attributed ROAS dashboards.
• Fix activation from signup to the first genuinely useful conversation, partnering closely with Engineering on the product experience.
• Own the retention curve. Aggregation alone does not retain users; finding and building the reason people return is part of this role.
• Land at least one distribution partnership through bundles, embeds, or integrations. One strong deal can outperform a quarter of auction-based spend.
• Prepare for trigger events such as breaches, policy changes, and industry scandals by building press relationships, publishable material, and a fast-response system before demand spikes.
• Manage growth through unit economics. The business resells inference, so gross margin, CAC payback, conversion, and lifetime value discipline are essential.

What We Are Looking For:
• You have taken a consumer or prosumer subscription product from near-zero to real scale and can discuss the retention curve honestly, including where it flattened and what did not work.
• You have operated with broken attribution, such as post-ATT mobile or DTC after iOS 14.5, and can explain how you designed a clean incrementality test.
• You can write. You can make a technical idea such as “the router never sees your prompt” meaningful to a non-technical professional without using jargon.
• You have built partnership distribution through BD, embeds, bundles, or integrations, not only paid auctions.
• You are comfortable with technical substance, can describe the architecture accurately, and can catch marketing claims that exceed what the product can prove.
• You think in unit economics and can make decisions using gross margin, CAC, payback period, LTV, and subscription revenue.

Nice to Have:
• Experience in privacy, security, or another trust-led category.
• A relevant existing audience.
• Growth experience across more than one geography.

This Is Probably Not for You If:
• You are a paid-media specialist who only wants to scale spend on a funnel someone else built.
• Your experience is primarily mobile games or app-install user acquisition without high-consideration, trust-led products.
• You want to hire a team before doing the work yourself.
• You need clean attribution to feel confident making a decision.

Practicalities:
• Full-time and fully remote, with approximately two months of in-person co-working each year. There is no fixed office; previous sessions have been held in Seoul and Shanghai, with future dates to be confirmed.
• APAC-based candidates are preferred, and US-based candidates will also be considered.
• Competitive compensation plus meaningful equity.
• Reports to the Founder.

How to Apply:
Contact Goldy and provide two items:
1. A short note on something you grew, including the channel mix, what the retention curve looked like, and what you would do differently.
2. A 200-word explanation of Vord AI for a 45-year-old accountant who has never thought about where AI prompts go. Use no jargon and show your judgment about what matters.

The second item is the real test and will be read first. No traditional cover letter is required, and the team does not screen for pedigree; it cares about what you have shipped.

descriptionEn:
About the Role:
Own North America social channels and creator collaborations for a consumer-facing proactive AI lifestyle product, reporting to the US Brand & Marketing Lead. The role focuses on finding the right micro-creators, building platform-native storytelling, and taking social accounts from cold start to sustained growth.

Responsibilities:
• Manage topic planning, content calendars, publishing, engagement, and performance reviews for North America social channels.
• Source and collaborate with local micro-influencers, emerging creators, and lifestyle accounts.
• Create authentic, shareable, platform-native content around city life, interest-based experiences, and proactive AI-assistant use cases.
• Track lifestyle media, city guides, and local social accounts to identify timely and relevant topics.
• Support account launches, content testing, creator programs, and priority campaigns with the Brand Lead.
• Maintain creator and content-partnership records and track reach, engagement, follower growth, traffic, and conversion.
• Work with Content Operations to translate vertical content and offline events into social-ready material.

Qualifications:
• 2+ years in social media, content operations, creator operations, or brand-account management.
• Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other major North American platforms.
• Understanding of micro-influencer sourcing, outreach, collaboration, and performance evaluation.
• Strong English content judgment and communication.
• US living experience is not required, but candidates must actively follow North American city culture and lifestyle media.
• Strong execution with the ability to independently own planning, publishing, creator communication, and review.

Nice to Have: lifestyle media, city content, consumer products, or AI products; experience building an English-language account from zero; or basic video editing, visual design, and creator-network development.

description:
岗位介绍：
你将深入达人营销的真实业务现场，把品牌从 Campaign 制定、达人筛选、建联邀约、议价签约、内容审核到发布复盘的复杂流程，抽象为可规模化、可复用的 AI 产品能力。这个岗位不只是传递需求，而是对问题定义、产品方案、落地过程和最终业务结果负责，与团队一起推动达人营销从人力密集型服务升级为 AI 驱动的全球交易与履约平台。

岗位职责：
• 深入达人营销业务，快速理解品牌从制定 Campaign、筛选达人、建联邀约、议价签约、内容审核到发布复盘的完整流程。
• 将客户、销售和运营侧的真实需求抽象为标准化产品能力，减少对人工操作和项目制交付的依赖。
• 负责需求分析、产品方案、原型设计、开发推进、上线验证及持续迭代，对产品最终落地结果负责。
• 与算法、研发、设计和业务团队紧密协作，推动 AI 在达人匹配、内容理解、自动沟通、风险判断和效果分析等场景落地。
• 深入一线观察用户使用过程，通过数据和反馈发现问题，对产品使用率、交付效率及业务结果负责。
• 持续研究全球 AI Agent、营销科技和 Creator Economy 产品，识别行业变化及产品机会。

任职要求：
• 本科及以上学历，国内外优秀高校毕业。
• 处于职业发展早期，具备 1–5 年 AI 或互联网产品相关经验；特别优秀的应届生也可考虑。
• 学习速度极快，能够在缺少既有经验和标准答案的情况下，快速理解陌生业务并抓住核心问题。
• 逻辑清晰、思维严谨，具备出色的业务抽象和系统设计能力，能够将复杂、非标准的人工流程转化为可复用的产品机制。
• 具备扎实的产品基本功，能够独立完成需求分析、产品设计、项目推进和上线验证，而不只是负责需求传递。
• 深度使用 AI 工具，能够主动运用大模型完成调研、分析、原型设计和产品验证，并对 AI 产品能力边界有基本判断。
• 对数据、用户体验和执行细节敏感，既能思考产品方向，也愿意深入一线解决具体问题。
• 主人翁意识强、行动速度快，能够适应高密度决策和快速变化的创业环境。
• 英文读写能力良好，能够直接研究海外产品并理解全球客户需求。

加分项：
• 有 AI Agent、AI 应用、多模态、推荐匹配或工作流自动化产品经验。
• 有达人营销、广告营销、内容平台、Creator Economy 或品牌出海相关经历。
• 有从 0 到 1 推动产品上线并通过数据验证业务价值的完整经验。
• 有高含金量竞赛、创业、研究、头部科技公司或高速成长团队经历。
• 能现场清晰拆解复杂问题，并迅速形成可执行的产品方案。

我们希望你是：
你不一定做过达人营销，但需要非常聪明，具备极强的学习能力、逻辑能力和产品判断力，能够在短时间内理解一个复杂行业。你正处于职业发展的上升期，沟通清晰且有影响力，拥有强烈的创业心态、主人翁意识和职场进取心；行动快、标准高，不依赖成熟流程和明确分工。你既能深入业务现场发现真实问题，也能跳出单个项目，将问题抽象成平台能力。
descriptionEn:
About the Role:
You will work directly with the realities of creator marketing and turn a complex campaign workflow—from campaign planning, creator discovery, outreach, negotiation, contracting, content review, and publishing through performance analysis—into scalable and reusable AI product capabilities. This is not a requirements-routing role. You will own problem definition, product design, delivery, and measurable business outcomes while helping transform creator marketing from a labor-intensive service into an AI-driven global transaction and fulfillment platform.

Responsibilities:
• Learn the complete creator-marketing workflow quickly, including campaign planning, creator selection, outreach, negotiation, contracting, content review, publishing, and post-campaign analysis.
• Abstract real customer, Sales, and Operations needs into standardized product capabilities that reduce dependence on manual work and project-based delivery.
• Own requirements analysis, product solutions, prototyping, development coordination, launch validation, and continuous iteration, with accountability for final adoption and outcomes.
• Partner closely with AI, Engineering, Design, and business teams to apply AI to creator matching, content understanding, automated communication, risk assessment, and performance analysis.
• Observe users in real workflows, identify problems through data and feedback, and improve product adoption, delivery efficiency, and business results.
• Continuously study global AI agents, marketing technology, and creator-economy products to identify market shifts and new product opportunities.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree or above from a strong university in China or abroad.
• Early in your career, with 1–5 years of experience in AI or internet product management; exceptional new graduates may also be considered.
• Exceptional learning speed and the ability to understand unfamiliar businesses and identify core problems without an established playbook.
• Clear, rigorous thinking with strong business abstraction and system-design ability, turning complex and non-standard manual workflows into reusable product mechanisms.
• Strong product fundamentals and the ability to independently own requirements, product design, project execution, and launch validation rather than simply passing along requests.
• Deep use of AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, and product validation, with sound judgment about the practical limits of AI products.
• Sensitivity to data, user experience, and execution details, with the ability to think strategically while solving concrete frontline problems.
• High ownership, fast execution, and comfort with dense decision-making and rapid change in a startup environment.
• Strong English reading and writing for researching global products and understanding international customer needs.

Nice to Have:
• Product experience with AI agents, AI applications, multimodal systems, recommendations and matching, or workflow automation.
• Experience in creator marketing, advertising, content platforms, the creator economy, or global brand expansion.
• A complete 0-to-1 product launch with business value validated through data.
• Strong achievements in competitions, entrepreneurship, research, leading technology companies, or high-growth teams.
• Ability to break down complex problems clearly in real time and quickly form an executable product plan.

Who You Are:
You may not have worked in creator marketing, but you are exceptionally quick to learn, reason clearly, and exercise strong product judgment. You are in a high-growth stage of your career, communicate with clarity and influence, and bring an entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership, and exceptional professional drive. You move fast, hold a high quality bar, and do not depend on mature processes or rigid role boundaries. You can discover real problems in frontline operations and then step back to turn them into platform capabilities.

description:

• 沟通清晰、有影响力，拥有强烈的创业心态、主人翁意识和职业进取心。

加分项：

聪明、产品抽象能力强、AI Native，能够把复杂业务经验转化为产品与 AI 能力；处于职业发展的上升期，沟通能力强，对结果有高标准，愿意在创业环境中主动承担并持续成长。
descriptionEn:
About the Role:
We are looking for a highly intelligent, AI-native Product Operations professional with strong abstraction skills. You will not personally run creator outreach, negotiations, or delivery follow-ups. Instead, you will understand the creator-marketing business and turn frontline experience and recurring problems into scalable product features, business rules, and AI capabilities.

Responsibilities:
• Understand the workflows of brands, creators, and operations teams and identify recurring, high-impact product problems.
• Abstract specific cases into reusable processes, product rules, and system capabilities.
• Help design and iterate core modules including creator matching, brief generation, content review, and campaign fulfillment.
• Translate business judgment into tasks that AI systems can understand, execute, and evaluate.
• Design and improve prompts, knowledge bases, AI workflows, and evaluation standards.
• Use user feedback and data to validate improvements in adoption, delivery efficiency, and business outcomes.
• Partner with Product, Engineering, AI, and business teams to drive projects through completion.

Qualifications:
• 2–5 years in product operations, strategy operations, growth operations, or AI products.
• Exceptional learning speed and the ability to understand complex, unfamiliar businesses without an established playbook.
• Strong abstraction, product judgment, and structured thinking; able to define scenarios, rules, and boundaries clearly.
• Deep practical use of LLMs for research, analysis, workflow design, and prototyping—not only content generation.
• High initiative and the ability to define and solve problems with incomplete information.
• Clear, influential communication, an entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership, and exceptional professional drive.
• English proficiency suitable for daily work.

Nice to Have:
• Creator marketing, international growth, or creator-economy experience.
• Hands-on use of Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar AI coding tools.
• Zero-to-one experience building product rules, taxonomy systems, or business workflows.
• Experience with AI agents, LLM applications, prompt engineering, or model evaluation.

Core Profile:
A fast-learning, AI-native operator with exceptional product abstraction who can convert complex business knowledge into scalable product and AI capabilities. You communicate strongly, hold a high bar for outcomes, and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment.

title: 数据交付工程师
description:
岗位职责：
• 负责视频、HDF5、JSON 等多模态数据的交付脚本开发与维护，保障数据从采集完成到对外交付的稳定流转。
• 根据项目需求设计和优化数据交付流程与工具，并沉淀为可复用能力。
• 分析和处理交付异常，做好问题记录、统计与定位。
• 与项目经理、算法及研发团队协作，快速响应交付规范和需求变化并推动闭环。
• 持续优化批量数据处理效率，减少人工干预成本。

任职要求：
• 本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、自动化或相关专业，具备 3–5 年 Python 工程或数据处理经验。

• 能独立编写可维护代码，具备异常处理、日志和代码结构设计意识。

descriptionEn:

• Design and optimize delivery workflows and tools for different projects, turning them into reusable capabilities.
• Analyze delivery exceptions and maintain clear records, metrics, and root-cause investigations.
• Work with project managers, AI teams, and engineers to respond quickly to specification changes and close issues.
• Improve batch-processing efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Automation, or a related field, with 3–5 years of Python engineering or data-processing experience.
• Strong Python skills and solid knowledge of file systems and common data formats.
• Ability to write maintainable code with sound exception handling, logging, and code-structure practices.
• Patience and ownership when diagnosing incomplete or inconsistent data.
• Strong cross-functional communication and execution.

Nice to Have: data engineering, data or annotation platforms, tooling, video, multimodal, or complex data-processing experience.

descriptionEn:

Responsibilities:

• Analyze data quality, explain why samples fall short, and recommend improvements.

description:

任职要求：

• 2 年以上复杂软硬件产品搭建、集成、测试或调试的工程实践。
• 能搭建并管理覆盖范围、里程碑、关键路径、预算、资源、依赖、验收标准和恢复方案的集成项目计划。

• 能在没有正式管理权限的情况下影响决策、明确责任并推动执行。

加分项：机器人、自动驾驶、工业自动化或仓储自动化经验；客户部署或系统验收经验；工程、计算机、机器人或相关技术学位。

为什么加入：

• 团队拥有多项机器人专利、顶级论文及最佳论文荣誉。
• 旗舰机器人连续获得北美头部物流自动化展会创新奖及全球机器人创新奖。
• 团队高速成长，岗位从第一天起拥有真实责任和广阔发展空间。
• 提供有意义的股权激励。

福利：家庭综合医疗保险、灵活带薪休假、带薪病假、401(k) 支持及每日餐补。

申请方式：通过 LinkedIn 联系 Goldy，并提交简历及相关材料。
descriptionEn:
About the Role:
The company builds general-purpose mobile manipulators for real industrial applications across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, including trailer unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending. Its systems combine perception, planning, controls, hardware, operations, and customer workflows. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will drive integrated execution of the highest-priority robotics programs from concept development and prototyping through validation, production/NPI, and customer deployment. Project owners retain ownership of their deliverables and engineering leads retain technical and people ownership; you own overall program alignment, visibility, and follow-through.

What You'll Do:
• Drive multiple concurrent software and hardware robotics programs from concept through validation, production/NPI, and deployment.
• Track commitments with project owners and team leads, surfacing risks, blockers, and scope changes before milestones are affected.
• Facilitate tradeoffs across technical scope, reliability, schedule, resources, cost, and customer priorities without taking technical ownership from engineering leads.
• Connect field requirements to development plans and coordinate Engineering, Testing, Operations, and customer-facing teams through acceptance and stabilization.
• Resolve cross-functional gaps by making ownership and next steps explicit across Software, Hardware, Testing, Deployment, and Operations.
• Use delivery history, engineering bandwidth, KPIs, and risk trends to support realistic roadmap commitments and concise leadership updates.

Required Skills:
• 3+ years of technical or engineering program management across multiple teams.
• 2+ years of hands-on engineering experience building, integrating, testing, or debugging complex hardware-software products.
• Experience building integrated plans covering scope, milestones, critical paths, budgets, resources, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and recovery actions.
• Strong scheduling, budgeting, resource planning, risk management, and milestone-definition skills.
• Ability to influence decisions, clarify ownership, and drive execution without formal authority.
• Strong communication and experience with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tools.
• Comfortable working onsite with engineering teams and physical robots.

Nice to Have: robotics, autonomous systems, industrial automation, or warehouse automation; customer deployment or system acceptance; technical degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.

Why Join:
• Work ships to real customer sites and runs in production at scale.
• The team has a strong patent, publication, and best-paper record.
• The flagship robot has earned consecutive innovation awards at major North American logistics-automation shows and a global robotics innovation award.
• A fast-growing team offers real ownership and room to expand your scope.
• Every team member receives meaningful equity.

Benefits: comprehensive family health insurance, flexible PTO, paid sick leave, 401(k) plan support, and a daily meal credit.

How to Apply: contact Goldy on LinkedIn and submit your resume and relevant materials.

descriptionEn:
About the Role:
This is the company's core hands-on marketing seat. Strategy and voice currently live with the co-founding team, and your job is to turn that direction into excellent work across every channel while owning how the company shows up to industrial buyers, partners, and the market. The role begins with the execution scope of a Marketing Manager and can quickly expand into strategy, budget, and team ownership as you deliver.

What You'll Do:
• Photography and video: shoot robots in action yourself or storyboard and art-direct a videographer, recognizing the moments that communicate real commercial value.
• Social: own and grow the company's presence across platforms, writing in a consistent voice and turning field footage into a steady content stream.
• Website: iterate pages, calls to action, and content to generate qualified sales leads and pipeline, not merely visual polish.
• Email: write recurring updates and nurture programs, including quarterly communications that keep target accounts warm.
• Events: run trade-show presence end to end, from booth and messaging through follow-up that converts conversations into pipeline.
• Grow over time into investor narrative, PR, and a larger role in marketing strategy.

What We're Looking For:
• 3–4 years of marketing experience with real shipped work to show. Consulting experience is welcome if you want to move from advising to building.
• Smart, driven, and highly accountable, able to orient quickly in ambiguity and measure yourself by what ships.
• Excellent English writing with the range to sound credible to industrial operations buyers and sharp in concise brand communication.
• Account-based marketing experience supporting B2B sales into named accounts and working with Sales to land and grow customers.
• A strong eye for photography and video, or the ability to translate a customer problem into a clear storyboard.
• Comfort building the marketing engine without an established playbook, large budget, or large team.

Nice to Have: warehouse, logistics, supply chain, manufacturing, or other industrial exposure; physical-product or hardware marketing; experience as an early startup's first or second marketing hire.

Why Join: the product operates at real customer sites; the team combines deep technical and academic strength; the flagship robot has earned multiple industry innovation awards; the company is growing quickly and offers meaningful equity.

Benefits: comprehensive family health insurance, PTO, paid sick leave, 401(k) plan support, and a daily meal credit.

How to Apply: contact Goldy on LinkedIn and submit your portfolio, resume, and relevant materials.

descriptionEn:
About the Role:
Join a national-scale intelligent input product team within a leading internet company and own AI product exploration and delivery. This role requires strong consumer insight together with meaningful technical depth: you should be able to engage with model, algorithm, and engineering details and work closely with technical teams to define product solutions and quality standards.

Responsibilities:
• Lead AI product planning for an intelligent input product, exploring applications of LLMs, agents, multimodal interaction, automatic speech recognition, and text-to-speech across text input, intelligent expression, voice interaction, and content creation.
• Study real user needs, expression habits, and end-to-end input journeys; design and deliver complete product solutions that improve efficiency and expression quality.
• Define model quality standards and evaluation frameworks based on business goals, partnering with Algorithm, Engineering, and Design on model iteration, strategy optimization, and data flywheels.
• Participate deeply in technical solution discussions, understand model limitations and data or engineering constraints, and balance user value, feasibility, and product experience.
• Track advances and competitors in foundation models, AI interaction, and intelligent input, proposing innovative strategies and validating them from zero to one.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree or above from a strong university; 211-level institutions or equivalent academic background preferred.
• 1+ years of product experience; prior algorithm experience is a plus.
• Consumer AI product experience with practical delivery experience in at least one area: LLMs, agents, multimodal interaction, ASR, or TTS. Experience with leading foundation-model assistants or intelligent-input products is preferred.
• Strong curiosity about AI and the ability to turn emerging technology into practical product solutions.
• High technical fluency and willingness to engage with algorithm and engineering details; experience contributing to technical design, model quality, or evaluation strategy is preferred.
• Strong consumer-product judgment and insight into input behavior, expression needs, and interaction quality, using data and research to guide decisions.
• Excellent systems thinking and problem decomposition, with the ability to own complex modules from zero to one.
• Sensitivity to language, voice, and content-creation experiences, with the judgment to define model goals that match real user scenarios.
• Strong execution and cross-functional leadership across Algorithm, Engineering, Design, and QA in a fast-paced environment.

Ideal Profile:
Candidates from established AI assistants, foundation-model applications, or intelligent-input products are especially relevant. The key is not requirement coordination alone, but the combination of user insight, AI product exploration, and the willingness and ability to go deep into technical details.

descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Join the China team of a London-headquartered technology unicorn and help shape a global digital note-taking, infinite-canvas, handwriting, learning, and collaboration experience used by tens of millions of people. The Shanghai team is building the next generation of AI-native product experiences on top of a strong global brand, healthy revenue growth, and long-term financial stability. You will own end-to-end interaction and visual design while ensuring that ideas ship successfully.

Why Join:
• Join as an early core member of the China team, contributing to zero-to-one product definition through a short decision chain.
• Work with experienced talent from leading internet companies in an AI-native environment with access to frontier models and generous AI tooling.
• Build on a globally established consumer brand, tens of millions of users, strong distribution, and healthy cash flow without fundraising pressure.
• Operate in a culture that encourages exploration, thoughtful risk-taking, and meaningful ownership, with a competitive package and an office in Shanghai's Xuhui Riverside.

Who We Are Looking For:
• A systems thinker who can evaluate user scenarios, business goals, and technical constraints together and anticipate downstream effects of design decisions.
• An independent driver who can clarify user scenarios and design hypotheses even when requirements are incomplete or direction remains open.
• A designer with sound judgment on experience details who can balance implementation cost and product quality and explain the trade-offs clearly.
• Someone accountable for shipped outcomes, willing to work deeply with engineers so design intent survives implementation and reaches users.
• A designer who keeps users present through interviews, usability studies, community feedback, and product data.

Key Responsibilities:
• Partner with Product Managers and business leaders to define new features, user scenarios, product strategy, and scope.
• Own interaction and visual design from exploration, user flows, information architecture, and state design through iteration, final UI, implementation support, and launch validation.
• Build and maintain the design system, design tokens, and component library to improve cross-platform consistency and delivery efficiency.
• Collaborate closely with engineers across iOS, Android, Web, and Desktop, understanding platform constraints and driving accurate implementation.
• Participate continuously in user interviews, usability testing, and community research, translating insight into actionable design direction.

Required Qualifications:
• 5+ years of product-design experience.
• Experience at a leading internet company or a product organization with comparable scale and complexity; strong familiarity with mature product-development processes and independent delivery in complex cross-functional environments.
• Excellent interaction-design skills across user flows, information architecture, and state design, grounded in product goals and user scenarios.
• Strong UI fundamentals across typography, color, information hierarchy, and component specifications, with sensitivity to system-level consistency.
• A systematic working style and the ability to break down complex requirements, create structured design artifacts, and drive cross-functional alignment.
• Excellent communication and the ability to explain design decisions clearly to Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders.
• A portfolio is required and should show the complete design process, key decisions, iterations, and final shipped work.

Preferred:
• Advanced use of AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Figma Make, with a personal methodology for integrating AI into design workflows.
• Mobile-app design experience, especially productivity, utility, note-taking, creation, or collaboration products.
• Design-system ownership or deep experience with cross-platform consistency.
• Fluent English for global collaboration and user research.
• Design-engineering experience, including coded prototypes or deep implementation collaboration with engineers.

• 熟悉漏斗分析、用户分层、留存分析和 A/B 实验，能够用数据判断机会与实验效果。
• 熟悉新增、激活、留存或召回中的至少一条增长链路，并有相关实践。
• 能把增长假设转化为清晰的 PRD、埋点和实验方案，跨团队推动上线。
• 高能动性、学习速度快、心态开放，对 AI 有信仰与实践。

加分项：

• 数据敏感，能够推动关键数据口径和看板建设。

descriptionEn:
Join the China Growth team and lead the product-led growth system for the local market. The role focuses on newly activated users and owns growth mechanisms across sharing, WeChat ecosystem conversion, onboarding, retention, and re-engagement, using data and A/B testing to validate and scale successful loops.

Responsibilities:
• Identify acquisition, activation, and retention levers from product capabilities, user journeys, behavior data, research, feedback, and business goals.
• Design sharing, referrals, invitations, campaigns, landing pages, redemption codes, and benefit-based growth loops.
• Build segmentation, activation, and re-engagement strategies across onboarding, push, in-app messaging, inbox, and WeChat service notifications.
• Design China-specific growth journeys across WeChat sharing and ecosystem handoffs.
• Define metrics and event tracking, build funnel dashboards, run A/B tests, and iterate from results.
• Turn hypotheses into clear product, instrumentation, and experiment plans and drive delivery across Product, Engineering, Design, Content, and Channel teams.

Qualifications:
• 3–5 years in user growth, product growth, or growth product management with a complete closed-loop case.
• Strong product thinking and the ability to identify and implement growth mechanisms.
• Hands-on knowledge of funnels, segmentation, retention analysis, and A/B testing.
• Practical experience in at least one of acquisition, activation, retention, or re-engagement.
• Ability to produce clear PRDs, tracking plans, and experiment designs and drive cross-functional delivery.
• High agency, learning speed, openness, and practical commitment to AI.

Bonus: consumer productivity, education, learning, or creation tools; referrals, WeChat conversion, incentives, onboarding, or re-engagement; analytics infrastructure; leading internet company or zero-to-one growth experience.

title: 产品经理（效率与协作方向）
workMode: 上海徐汇滨江线下办公
description:
岗位介绍：
加入中国区创始团队，负责数字笔记、编辑器与协作体验的产品定义和落地。你将直接参与从 0 到 1 的产品决策，围绕移动端、桌面端与跨端场景，连接用户需求、数据洞察和复杂技术能力，打造自然、高效、可靠的记录与协作体验。

岗位职责：
• 负责效率与协作产品的需求洞察、产品规划、方案设计、研发推进、上线验证和持续迭代。
• 深入研究数字书写、富文本编辑、信息组织、多端同步和多人协作等核心场景。
• 独立完成用户流程、信息架构、交互逻辑、边界状态和原型方案，并与设计团队共同提升体验。
• 通过数据分析、用户研究和 A/B 实验验证产品判断，持续优化关键体验与业务指标。
• 与客户端、服务端及基础架构团队高效协作，理解并推动实时同步、多人编辑和跨端一致性等复杂方案。
• 探索 AI 在记录、学习、内容理解、创作和协作工作流中的产品化机会。

任职要求：

• 具备移动端或桌面端产品经验，效率类或协作类应用经验优先。
• 数据驱动，能够基于指标、分析和 A/B 实验做产品决策。
• 交互设计基本功扎实，可在不依赖设计师的情况下输出清晰的用户流程、信息架构与状态设计。
• 产品思维和用户体验意识强，对细节和完整性有高标准。
• 理解技术实现，能够与研发团队讨论并推动复杂技术方案。

加分项：
• 有富文本编辑器、文档协作、效率工具或知识管理产品经验。
• 有多人协同编辑和实时同步功能的设计或落地经验。
• 熟悉 ProseMirror、Slate、Lexical 等编辑器框架。
• 理解 CRDT、OT 等协同算法及其对产品设计的影响。
• 熟练使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 AI 工具，并有将其融入产品工作流的方法。

descriptionEn:
Join the founding China team and own product definition and delivery across digital note-taking, editor, and collaboration experiences. You will participate directly in zero-to-one decisions and connect user needs, data insights, and complex technical capabilities across mobile, desktop, and cross-platform workflows.

Responsibilities:
• Own discovery, planning, product design, engineering execution, launch validation, and iteration for productivity and collaboration experiences.

• Independently design user flows, information architecture, interaction logic, edge states, and prototypes.
• Validate decisions through analytics, user research, and A/B testing.
• Partner with client, backend, and infrastructure teams on real-time sync, collaborative editing, and cross-platform consistency.
• Explore AI-native opportunities in note-taking, learning, content understanding, creation, and collaboration.

Qualifications:
• 5+ years of internet product-management experience with independent ownership of complex products or core modules.
• Mobile or desktop product experience; productivity or collaboration products preferred.
• Data-driven decision-making and strong A/B testing experience.

Bonus: rich-text editors, document collaboration, productivity or knowledge tools; multiplayer editing or real-time sync; ProseMirror, Slate, or Lexical; CRDT or OT; AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor; fluent English.

岗位职责：
• 为服务数千万全球用户的平台级系统制定产品战略、路线图和优先级。
• 将欧洲、中东及亚洲主要监管要求转化为可扩展的合规、KYC、AML、新市场启动和业务迁移方案。
• 推动账户架构、身份验证、安全风控和用户生命周期管理能力建设。
• 负责充提、统一账户、多链资产管理及现实世界资产整合等资金与资产基础设施。
• 推动 LLM、RAG 和 Agent 在客户服务与内部效率场景中的产品化落地。
• 将复杂业务、监管和技术需求转化为清晰 PRD，协同工程、设计、合规和运营完成端到端交付。
• 负责人级岗位需带领约 20 人团队，建立目标、协作机制、人才发展与质量标准。

任职要求：
• 7 年以上产品管理经验，其中 3 年以上来自合规、账户系统、支付资金或 AI 产品等相关领域。
• 有数字资产平台、金融科技、券商或大型互联网平台经验。
• 系统性思维突出，能够进行架构级产品设计并平衡体验、安全与合规。
• 有复杂跨职能产品成功交付经历；负责人级候选人需具备团队管理经验。
• 英语流利，能够与全球利益相关方高效沟通。
• 数据驱动，分析与决策能力强。

加分项：
• 头部数字资产平台、顶级金融科技或券商经验。
• 在强监管或高安全环境中完成 0 到 1 产品发布。
• 熟悉区块链基础设施、多链架构或链上资产管理。
• 有大规模 LLM 或 AI 产品开发和部署经验。
descriptionEn:
Own mission-critical platform systems powering global digital-asset and financial infrastructure. Depending on strengths, the role may focus on compliance and regulatory products, user accounts and identity, fund and asset infrastructure, or AI-powered products. Head-level candidates will lead a platform product organization of roughly 20 people; expert-level candidates will own architecture-level product design and complex delivery in a critical domain.

Responsibilities:
• Define product strategy, roadmaps, and priorities for platform systems serving tens of millions of users.
• Translate major European, Middle Eastern, and Asian regulatory frameworks into scalable compliance, KYC/AML, market-launch, and migration solutions.
• Build account architecture, authentication, security, risk-control, and lifecycle capabilities.
• Own deposit and withdrawal systems, unified accounts, multi-chain asset management, and real-world asset integration.
• Productize LLM, RAG, and agent capabilities for customer-facing and internal use cases.
• Convert complex business, regulatory, and technical needs into clear specifications and drive cross-functional delivery.
• At Head level, lead a team of about 20 and establish goals, operating mechanisms, talent development, and quality standards.

Requirements:
• 7+ years in product management, including 3+ years in compliance, account systems, payments/funds, or AI products.
• Experience in digital assets, fintech, brokerage, or large-scale internet platforms.
• Strong systems thinking and architecture-level product design.
• Proven complex cross-functional delivery; people management required for Head-level candidates.
• Fluent English and strong data-driven decision-making.

Preferred: leading digital-asset, fintech, or brokerage experience; zero-to-one launches in regulated or high-security environments; blockchain or multi-chain infrastructure; large-scale LLM/AI product deployment.

title: 首席 AI Agent 开发工程师 / 架构师
titleEn: Principal AI Agent Development Engineer / Architect
workMode: 吉隆坡办公
description:

• 端到端负责准确率、解决率、成本和延迟，通过数据反馈建立个性化优化闭环。

任职要求：
• 计算机相关本科及以上，6 年以上经验，其中 3 年以上 AI 或 Agent 经验。
• 精通 Go 或 Python，具备生产级系统设计和 TRD 撰写能力。
• 深入掌握 LLM API、Prompt Engineering、ReAct 与上下文窗口管理。
• 有生产级 Agent 从 0 到 1 上线和持续迭代经验，非 Demo 或 POC。

title: 首席技术官（CTO）
workMode: 全球寻访；深圳主体筹备中
workModeEn: Global executive search; Shenzhen entity in formation
description:
职位定位：
作为公司核心管理团队和创始团队级技术领导者，与创始团队共同制定技术战略，负责构建新一代 AI 营销操作系统，形成公司的核心技术壁垒并建立具有国际竞争力的研发体系。我们寻找的不是单纯的研发负责人，而是能够定义产品技术方向、亲自主导核心架构、建设 AI 平台并带领团队从创业阶段走向规模化的技术领导者。

核心职责：
1. 技术战略与整体架构
• 制定中长期技术路线图，设计 AI Native 平台整体架构、统一规范与研发标准。
• 决定平台演进策略和技术选型，平衡产品创新、先进性、工程效率、成本与长期扩展性。
• 建立能够持续支撑业务增长和全球化交付的核心技术壁垒。

2. AI 平台与 Agent 架构
• 构建生产级企业 AI Agent 平台，覆盖 Agentic AI、Multi-Agent 协同、Planning、Reasoning、Execution、RAG 与 Tool Calling。
• 建设用户记忆、组织记忆与 Agent 记忆体系，以及 Context Engineering、上下文生命周期、模型路由和 Prompt 编排能力。
• 搭建工作流编排、Human-in-the-loop、AI Evaluation、Benchmark、Observability、Guardrails 与 Governance。
• 对真实生产环境中的准确性、稳定性、可控性、成本与持续迭代负责，而非停留在 PoC 或 Demo。

3. 企业级平台工程
• 建设支持全球企业客户的分布式、Cloud Native、微服务、API First 与事件驱动架构。
• 完善 Kubernetes、容器编排、Infrastructure as Code、CI/CD、高可用、灾难恢复、性能工程、可观测性与成本优化。

4. 安全、隐私与治理
• 将 IAM、认证授权、RBAC、多租户、静态及传输加密、Secrets Management、审计日志、数据治理和 Privacy by Design 作为平台基础能力。
• 建设 Zero Trust 架构，并推动 SOC 2、ISO 27001、GDPR、PDPA 等企业级合规能力。

5. 数据平台与 Memory
• 负责企业知识管理、Knowledge Graph、Vector Database、长期记忆、语义检索、权限感知检索和上下文持久化。
• 建设 Data Pipeline、Event Streaming、实时处理、数据治理及信息生命周期管理，形成组织知识沉淀和 AI 长期记忆能力。

6. AI First 产品体验
• 与产品和设计团队共同打造 Conversational Interface、Proactive AI、Explainable AI、决策透明、人类监督和低摩擦工作流。
• 用技术架构支撑极简、高效、可信且智能的产品体验。

7. 国际研发组织建设
• 从 0 到 1 建设 AI、平台、后端、前端、基础设施、数据与安全工程团队。
• 建立研发流程、工程文化、质量标准和技术管理机制，持续吸引和培养国际化技术人才。

候选人要求：
• 在 LLM、Agentic AI、Multi-Agent、RAG、Memory Architecture、Prompt/Context Engineering、Model Routing、AI Evaluation、Observability 与 Governance 等方向有深入生产实践。
• 熟悉 Enterprise SaaS、分布式系统、Cloud Native、Kubernetes、Docker、AWS/Azure/GCP、微服务、事件驱动、API 平台、IaC 与 CI/CD。
• 具备 PostgreSQL、向量数据库、知识图谱、Kafka 或同类消息系统、数据仓库、ETL/ELT 与实时分析经验。
• 熟悉 Enterprise Identity、RBAC、加密、多租户、审计、隐私工程、Secure SDLC 与企业合规。
• 具备卓越的系统架构与技术战略能力、AI Native 产品思维和强工程质量意识。
• 有从 0 到 1 建设技术平台及研发团队，并带领团队从创业阶段走向规模化的经验。
• 能在高度不确定环境中作出高质量决策，平衡短期业务目标与长期技术演进。
• 跨部门沟通与协作能力出色，能够与产品、设计、商业和管理团队共同推进复杂项目。

优先背景：
• 来自 AI Native 企业、Enterprise SaaS、Developer Platform、Productivity Software、Cloud Infrastructure 或企业级 AI 平台。
• 有面向大型企业客户构建并规模化交付 AI 产品的经验。

未来 24–36 个月成功标准：
• 建成能够支撑全球企业客户的 AI Native 平台和长期核心技术壁垒。
• 建立企业级安全、隐私与治理体系。
• 建设国际化研发团队，以及 AI Orchestration、Memory、Automation 等核心能力。
• 在持续快速创新的同时，保障平台稳定性、安全性与可扩展性。

不匹配画像：
• 偏研发管理但缺乏核心架构设计经验；偏企业 IT、信息化或基础设施管理的 CTO/CIO。
• 主要从事学术研究但缺乏商业产品落地；仅集成第三方 AI 能力、缺乏底层 AI 平台架构经验。
• 缺乏企业级 SaaS、安全体系或大型平台建设经验。
descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Join the core executive team as a founder-level technology leader. Partner with the founders to define the technology strategy, build a next-generation AI marketing operating system, establish durable technical differentiation, and create an internationally competitive engineering organization. This is not a conventional R&D-management role: the CTO must define product and technology direction, personally lead core architecture, build a production AI platform, and scale the organization from startup stage to global delivery.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Technology Strategy and Architecture
• Define the long-term technology roadmap, AI-native platform architecture, engineering standards, platform evolution, and technology choices.
• Balance product innovation, technical ambition, delivery speed, cost, reliability, and long-term scalability.

2. AI Platform and Agent Architecture
• Build a production-grade enterprise agent platform spanning agentic AI, multi-agent collaboration, planning, reasoning, execution, RAG, and tool calling.
• Develop user, organizational, and agent memory; context engineering and lifecycle management; model routing; and prompt orchestration.
• Establish workflow orchestration, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, benchmarks, observability, guardrails, and governance.
• Own production quality, controllability, reliability, cost, and iteration beyond PoCs or demos.

3. Enterprise Platform Engineering
• Build distributed, cloud-native, microservice, API-first, and event-driven systems for global enterprise customers.
• Establish Kubernetes, container orchestration, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, high availability, disaster recovery, performance engineering, platform observability, and cost optimization.

4. Security, Privacy, and Governance
• Make IAM, authentication and authorization, RBAC, multi-tenancy, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, data governance, and privacy by design foundational platform capabilities.
• Build toward zero-trust architecture and enterprise standards including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and PDPA.

5. Data Platform and Memory
• Own enterprise knowledge management, knowledge graphs, vector databases, long-term memory, semantic and permission-aware retrieval, and context persistence.
• Build data pipelines, event streaming, real-time processing, governance, and information lifecycle management.

6. AI-First Product Experience
• Partner with Product and Design on conversational interfaces, proactive and explainable AI, decision transparency, human oversight, workflow simplification, and low-friction user experiences.

7. Global Engineering Organization
• Build AI, platform, backend, frontend, infrastructure, data, and security engineering teams from zero.
• Establish engineering culture, quality standards, operating mechanisms, and a strong international talent pipeline.

Candidate Requirements:
• Deep production experience across LLMs, agentic AI, multi-agent systems, RAG, memory architecture, prompt and context engineering, model routing, evaluation, observability, and governance.
• Strong enterprise SaaS and platform architecture across distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, Kubernetes, Docker, major clouds, microservices, event-driven systems, APIs, IaC, and CI/CD.
• Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, knowledge graphs, Kafka or equivalent messaging, data warehouses, ETL/ELT, and real-time analytics.
• Strong understanding of enterprise identity, RBAC, encryption, multi-tenancy, auditing, privacy engineering, secure SDLC, and compliance.
• Exceptional architecture, technology-strategy, AI-native product, and engineering-quality judgment.
• Proven zero-to-one platform and team building, followed by successful scaling.
• Strong cross-functional leadership and high-quality decision-making under uncertainty.

Preferred Background:
AI-native companies, enterprise SaaS, developer platforms, productivity software, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise AI platforms; experience building AI products for large enterprise customers is strongly preferred.

Success in 24–36 Months:
Build a globally scalable AI-native platform and durable technical moat; establish enterprise security, privacy, and governance; create an international engineering organization; develop core AI orchestration, memory, and automation capabilities; and sustain fast product innovation without sacrificing reliability, security, or scalability.

Not a Fit:
R&D managers without hands-on architecture ownership; enterprise IT or infrastructure-management CTO/CIO profiles; academic AI leaders without commercial product delivery; leaders dependent primarily on third-party AI integrations; or candidates without enterprise SaaS, security, and large-platform experience.

descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Own the vision, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of next-generation AI-native smart hardware. Combine frontier AI capabilities, the real needs of global professionals, and consumer-electronics execution to create new human-AI interfaces. The US team currently has approximately eight people and expects this role to establish a strong local loop from user insight and product definition through cross-functional delivery. During mass-production phases, the role will partner closely with engineering, supply-chain, and manufacturing teams in China. This position reports to the partner leading the hardware business.

What You Will Do:
• Shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for next-generation AI-native smart hardware, turning bold ideas into real experiences.
• Dive deeply into the work environments, habits, aesthetics, purchasing behavior, and smart-device needs of professionals worldwide.
• Partner with AI, industrial design, app, firmware, electronics, mechanical, manufacturing, and operations teams to deliver seamless hardware-software experiences.
• Lead products from concept sketches and prototypes through EVT, DVT, PVT, and mass production, owning experience, quality, cost, and launch readiness.
• Use feedback, data, market trends, and validation results to continuously refine and evolve products.
• Make clear product and technical trade-offs across system design, scope, cost, power, reliability, and schedule.

What We Look For:
• Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, industrial design, computer science, or a related field.
• 5+ years of product-management experience in wearables, consumer electronics, or AI hardware; consumer-electronics experience is required.
• Strong command of the hardware development lifecycle, including concept design, prototyping, EVT/DVT/PVT, and mass production.
• Good understanding of electronics, mechanics, firmware, system integration, manufacturing, suppliers, cost control, validation, quality, and reliability.
• Familiarity with AI applications in smart hardware, including voice interaction, sensors, low-power computing, and edge AI.
• A global product perspective and deep understanding of international professionals' work habits, aesthetics, purchasing behavior, and smart-device usage.
• Ability to work closely with engineers and make sound technical trade-offs, with strong ownership, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Basic awareness of regulatory and certification requirements such as FCC, CE, and PTCRB.
• Professional fluency in both English and Chinese for collaboration across the US and China.

Preferred:
AI-driven consumer products, wearables, industrial design, sensors, embedded AI systems, or successful zero-to-one and mass-production launches for global markets.

Why Join:
Help define the next paradigm for human-AI interaction at a fast-growing and profitable global AI-hardware company. Benefits include meaningful equity, competitive compensation, comprehensive health and retirement plans, unlimited PTO, paid parental leave, frontier AI tools, and best-in-class equipment.
