descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Own positioning, messaging, product storytelling, and go-to-market execution for the company's AI software and productivity experiences. Partner with Product, AI, Creative, and regional Marketing teams to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, credible, and actionable user value.

What You Will Do:
• Align with Product on roadmaps and create value propositions, positioning, message houses, use cases, and product and feature descriptions for software and AI offerings.
• Partner with Creative to deliver landing pages, blogs, videos, visuals, and campaign copy with clear and consistent messaging across channels.
• Drive go-to-market storytelling and execution for software and AI launches.
• Enable Sales, Marketing, Support, and regional teams through product training, enablement decks, and internal briefs.
• Use feedback, product data, and competitive intelligence to continuously improve differentiation, messaging hierarchy, and content quality.
• Apply AI tools throughout research, writing, content development, and iteration.

Minimum Qualifications:
• 2–4 years of product-marketing experience, preferably in SaaS, AI, or productivity technology.
• Strong content-creation skills across product messaging, feature descriptions, use cases, marketing copy, and the translation of technical concepts into user benefits.
• Excellent written and verbal English communication.
• A data-driven mindset with a balance of analytical and creative thinking.
• Familiarity with go-to-market and product-marketing frameworks, including positioning and message-house development.
• Excellent storytelling, structured writing, and cross-functional collaboration across time zones.
• Ability to synthesize product data, user insight, and competitive intelligence into actionable messaging and content improvements.

Compensation and Benefits:
• US$120,000–160,000 base salary, plus performance bonus and equity.
• Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) benefits; unlimited PTO, 13 paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave.
• Frontier AI tools, best-in-class equipment, annual offsites, and a high-impact growth environment.

title: 美洲高级产品营销经理
workMode: San Francisco Hybrid，每周至少 3 天办公室；负责美洲市场
workModeEn: San Francisco hybrid, minimum three days per week in office; Americas remit
description:
岗位介绍：
负责公司 AI 软件与智能硬件在美洲市场的高级产品营销战略和 GTM，建立区域定位、用户叙事、发布方法与增长协同机制。该岗位要求具备扎实的 AI 软件产品营销背景；智能硬件或消费电子经验是重要加分项。

岗位职责：
• 制定美洲市场产品营销战略、年度重点和 GTM 路线图，对定位、信息体系、市场进入和发布质量负责。
• 深入理解美国及美洲专业用户、团队客户和行业场景，将 AI 软件与软硬件一体化能力转化为差异化价值主张。
• 主导重点产品及功能发布，统筹 Narrative、Message House、Use Case、Launch Plan、渠道内容和市场反馈闭环。
• 与产品、AI、硬件、销售、客户成功、品牌、增长和创意团队协作，推动从产品洞察到商业结果的完整落地。
• 建立美洲市场竞争情报、用户研究和反馈机制，为产品路线图与区域优先级提供输入。
• 建设销售与合作伙伴 Enablement 体系，包括行业方案、演示材料、客户故事和内部培训。
• 通过产品采用、功能激活、渠道表现、Pipeline 贡献和用户反馈评估 GTM 成效并持续优化。
• 指导重点项目及外部合作资源，逐步建立可规模化的区域产品营销方法。

任职要求：
• 5 年以上产品营销、GTM 或相关经验，并有独立负责重要产品或区域市场的成功案例。
• 必须具备 AI 软件、SaaS、生产力工具或 AI 应用产品背景；能够准确理解并表达模型及软件能力。
• 有智能硬件、消费电子、可穿戴设备或软硬件一体化产品经验者优先。
• 深入理解美洲市场、专业用户与企业客户，能够完成本地化定位而非简单翻译全球内容。
• 具备优秀的产品叙事、结构化写作、发布管理和跨职能推动能力。
• 数据意识强，能够结合产品使用、用户研究、竞争格局和商业数据作出判断。
• 英语母语或近母语水平；能与全球跨时区团队高效协作。
• 高度自驱，能够在快速变化和信息不完整的环境中建立方向并推动执行。

岗位亮点：
• 在高速增长、已盈利的全球 AI 智能硬件公司中定义美洲产品营销体系。
• 直接参与下一代 AI 软件、生产力工具与智能硬件的全球化发布。
• 提供具有竞争力的薪酬、股权、完善福利、Unlimited PTO、先进 AI 工具和高规格设备。
descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Own senior product-marketing strategy and go-to-market execution across the Americas for AI software and smart-hardware experiences. Build regional positioning, user narratives, launch discipline, and growth alignment. A strong AI-software product-marketing background is required; smart-hardware or consumer-electronics experience is a meaningful advantage.

What You Will Do:
• Define the Americas product-marketing strategy, annual priorities, and GTM roadmap, owning positioning, messaging architecture, market entry, and launch quality.
• Develop a deep understanding of professional users, teams, and industry workflows across the Americas, translating AI software and integrated hardware-software capabilities into differentiated value propositions.
• Lead major product and feature launches across narrative, message houses, use cases, launch plans, channel content, and market-feedback loops.
• Partner with Product, AI, Hardware, Sales, Customer Success, Brand, Growth, and Creative to connect product insight with commercial outcomes.
• Establish regional competitive-intelligence, user-research, and feedback systems that influence the product roadmap and market priorities.
• Build Sales and partner enablement through industry solutions, demos, customer stories, and internal training.
• Measure GTM performance through product adoption, feature activation, channel results, pipeline contribution, and user feedback.
• Guide strategic projects and external resources while building a scalable regional product-marketing practice.

What We Look For:
• 5+ years of product marketing, GTM, or related experience, including ownership of meaningful product launches or regional markets.
• Required background in AI software, SaaS, productivity tools, or AI applications, with the ability to understand and communicate model and software capabilities accurately.
• Smart-hardware, consumer-electronics, wearable, or integrated hardware-software experience is preferred.
• Deep understanding of professional and enterprise audiences in the Americas and the ability to create native regional positioning rather than simply localize global content.
• Excellent product storytelling, structured writing, launch management, and cross-functional influence.
• Strong analytical judgment across product usage, research, competition, and commercial data.
• Native or near-native English and strong global, cross-time-zone collaboration.
• High ownership and comfort creating direction in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

Why Join:
Define product marketing across the Americas at a fast-growing and profitable global AI-hardware company. Shape launches for next-generation AI software, productivity tools, and smart hardware, with competitive compensation, equity, comprehensive benefits, unlimited PTO, frontier AI tools, and best-in-class equipment.

title: AI 产品设计师
workMode: 上海办公，具体安排面议
workModeEn: Shanghai-based; work arrangement to be discussed
description:
岗位职责：
• 负责 AI 产品从 0 到 1 的产品设计，覆盖用户研究、产品定义、信息架构、交互设计与体验打磨。
• 将高度模糊的问题快速拆解，通过原型、Demo 和用户反馈持续验证产品方向。
• 与 AI 全栈工程师深度协作，共同完成产品设计、实现和迭代，而非传统上下游交接模式。
• 深入理解用户行为，持续优化每一个影响用户感受的细节，并通过做减法保持产品清晰易用。
• 关注 AI 产品、交互和模型能力的发展趋势，将新的技术能力快速转化为真实用户价值。

任职要求：
• 产品 Sense 出色，不只思考“怎么做”，也能判断“为什么做”和“是否值得做”。
• 能独立完成产品逻辑与体验设计，并与工程师平等讨论产品及技术方案。
• 对用户体验有敏锐判断，理解优秀交互背后的原则，避免无效功能堆叠。
• 信息架构、交互设计和产品表达能力强，能够快速输出高质量方案。
• 面对不确定性能够主动形成假设、快速验证并持续迭代。

加分项：
• 有创业、内部孵化或 Side Project 等完整 0 到 1 产品经历。
• 有 AI 产品设计经验，理解大语言模型与多模态模型的优势和边界。
• 熟练使用 Figma、Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等 AI Native 工具。
• 对产品细节要求高，能兼顾用户价值、体验质量与商业目标。
• 拥有公开作品集、设计文章、个人项目或其他可展示成果。
descriptionEn:
Responsibilities:
• Design AI products from zero to one across user research, product definition, information architecture, interaction design, and experience craft.
• Break down ambiguous problems quickly and validate direction through prototypes, demos, and user feedback.
• Work as a true product-building partner with AI full-stack engineers across design, implementation, and iteration.
• Understand behavior deeply, refine every important detail, and simplify rather than accumulate features.
• Turn emerging AI and interaction capabilities into meaningful user value.

Requirements:
• Exceptional product sense and judgment about why a product or feature should exist.
• Ability to define product logic independently and debate solutions with engineers as an equal partner.
• Strong user-experience judgment, interaction principles, information architecture, and product communication.
• Ability to form hypotheses and iterate quickly under high uncertainty.

Preferred: complete zero-to-one product experience; AI product design and understanding of LLM or multimodal boundaries; proficiency with Figma, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI-native tools; excellent craft; and a public portfolio, writing, or personal projects.

profile.experience: 完整产品设计经验；0-1经历优先
profile.experienceEn: End-to-end product design; zero-to-one experience preferred

title: 模型策略产品经理（互动内容）
titleEn: Model Strategy Product Manager, Interactive Content
workMode: 上海办公，具体安排面议
workModeEn: Shanghai-based; work arrangement to be discussed
description:
岗位职责：
• 负责 AI 互动内容方向，结合前沿 AI 能力探索娱乐内容的新形态、新玩法和新增长机会。
• 基于对轻度游戏和泛娱乐生态的理解，定义核心内容品类、互动玩法及可准出的效果标准。
• 设计并搭建互动内容核心 Agent 工作流，对关键链路和最终内容体验负责。
• 建设标准化 Benchmark 评测集、评测方案和量化标准，持续评估并优化模型内容效果。
• 通过 Prompt 调优、数据治理和用户反馈回流，与算法团队共同推动模型微调与迭代，建立效果优化闭环。
• 协调算法、工程、设计和内容团队，独立推动互动内容项目从 0 到 1 上线。

任职要求：
• 2 年以上 AI 模型策略产品经验，具备 AI Native 思维，理解大模型与 Agent 的能力边界。
• 具备 Agent 链路搭建、模型评测体系建设、Prompt 优化等核心策略实践。
• 逻辑清晰、执行力强，能独立推进 0 到 1 项目并完成跨团队协作。
• 日常关注或体验轻度游戏，理解小游戏和泛娱乐用户的核心需求。

加分项：有游戏内容平台、互动娱乐或 UGC 游戏生态经验；熟悉轻度游戏玩法设计、内容评测、模型微调或多模态生成。

最新岗位重点：该方向与用户产品的互动玩法岗位紧密协作，但更强调模型能力边界、Agent 链路、Prompt、数据与评测闭环。团队当前对模型策略人才需求紧急，优秀 Senior 人选可进一步承担方向 POC。
descriptionEn:
Responsibilities:
• Own AI interactive-content strategy and explore new entertainment formats, gameplay, and growth opportunities enabled by frontier AI.
• Define core content categories, interactive mechanics, and release-quality standards through a strong understanding of casual gaming and entertainment ecosystems.
• Design and build the core agent workflows behind interactive content.
• Establish benchmark datasets, evaluation methods, and quantitative standards for model-generated experiences.
• Create a model-improvement loop through prompt optimization, data governance, user feedback, and close collaboration with AI researchers.
• Lead cross-functional zero-to-one delivery across AI, Engineering, Design, and Content.

Requirements:
• 2+ years in AI model-strategy products, with AI-native judgment and understanding of LLM and agent boundaries.
• Hands-on experience with agent workflows, model evaluation, benchmarks, and prompt optimization.
• Strong logic, execution, ownership, and cross-functional leadership in zero-to-one projects.

Preferred: game-content platforms, interactive entertainment, UGC gaming ecosystems, gameplay design, model tuning, or multimodal generation.

Model strategy is an urgent hiring area, and an exceptional senior candidate may grow into direction-level POC ownership.

title: AI 大模型资源采购专家
workMode: 杭州办公；中高级专家职级，计划招聘 2–3 人
description:
岗位背景：
随着集团内大模型训练和 AI 应用快速扩张，业务需要持续采购外部模型 API、MaaS 服务、企业账号、调用额度及相关技术能力。本岗位既要理解模型与产品，也要完成供应商评估、商务采购和交付管理，让外部 AI 能力能够稳定、合规且具有成本效率地进入内部业务。

岗位职责：
• 负责大模型 API、MaaS 平台、企业账号、调用额度及相关 AI 技术服务的市场研究、供应商开拓和采购交付。
• 深入理解内部产品、算法和工程团队的使用场景，将模型能力需求转化为清晰的技术、商务、SLA、安全与合规规格。
• 从效果、延迟、稳定性、上下文能力、并发限制、成本、数据安全、部署方式和服务支持等维度建立选型与评估体系。
• 推动 POC、比选、商务谈判、合同、接入、验收、续约和成本优化，对完整采购生命周期负责。
• 建立模型资源地图、供应商池和价格基准，跟踪国内外模型与 MaaS 市场变化，及时识别替代方案和供应风险。
• 协同产品、算法、工程、安全、法务、财务及采购团队，推动复杂项目按期落地。

任职要求：
• 具备大模型、MaaS、AI 应用、技术采购、产品、算法解决方案或生态商务相关经验。
• 理解 LLM API 与 MaaS 的基本产品和技术逻辑，包括模型效果、Token/计费、限流、上下文、RAG/微调、可用性及数据安全。
• 能把技术需求转化为采购标准，兼具产品判断、商业分析、谈判和项目推进能力。
• 能与算法工程师、产品团队和供应商技术团队进行有效沟通，并在多方目标间完成取舍。
• 有复杂供应商管理、企业服务采购或跨境 AI 资源合作经验者优先。

参考人才背景（仅用于帮助理解画像，不构成定向挖猎名单）：
• 国内外 MaaS 平台、模型服务商或 AI 基础设施公司的产品、算法、解决方案及商业岗位。
• 头部模型公司，例如字节、腾讯、智谱、MiniMax、月之暗面、DeepSeek 等相关团队。
• 在金融、教育、医疗、营销、企业服务等垂直领域推动 AI 应用落地的产品经理。
descriptionEn:
Role Context:
As model training and AI applications scale across the group, the business needs reliable access to external model APIs, MaaS platforms, enterprise accounts, usage credits, and related technical capabilities. This role combines technical product judgment with sourcing, commercial negotiation, and delivery ownership.

Responsibilities:
• Source and procure model APIs, MaaS services, enterprise accounts, capacity credits, and related AI services.
• Translate internal product, research, and engineering use cases into technical, commercial, SLA, security, and compliance requirements.
• Build evaluation frameworks covering quality, latency, reliability, context, rate limits, cost, data security, deployment, and support.
• Own POCs, vendor selection, negotiation, contracting, integration, acceptance, renewal, and cost optimization.
• Maintain a model-resource landscape, supplier pipeline, and pricing benchmarks while managing supply risk.
• Coordinate Product, AI, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, and Procurement.

Requirements:
Experience across LLMs, MaaS, AI applications, technical procurement, product, AI solutions, or ecosystem partnerships; practical understanding of LLM APIs and MaaS economics; strong technical-to-commercial translation, negotiation, and program ownership.

Reference backgrounds only—not a targeted poaching list: product, AI, solutions, or commercial talent from MaaS and AI-infrastructure providers; relevant teams at model companies such as ByteDance, Tencent, Zhipu AI, MiniMax, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek; or product managers building AI applications in vertical industries.

profile.experience: 中高级专家；大模型、MaaS、AI应用或技术采购经验
profile.experienceEn: Mid-to-senior expert with LLM, MaaS, AI application, or technical procurement experience

title: AI Native 采购解决方案专家
workMode: 杭州办公；资深专家职级，计划招聘 2–3 人
description:
岗位背景：
传统采购覆盖需求提出、寻源、供应商准入、询比价、合同、验收、结算和风险管理等复杂环节。本岗位需要把大模型、Agent、RAG、知识库和自动化工作流真正接入采购系统，重构工作流程与协作范式，而不是只做单点工具或概念验证。

岗位职责：
• 梳理采购全链路，识别高频、耗时、依赖人工判断且适合 AI 改造的关键场景。
• 规划并落地采购 Copilot、Agent、智能寻源、需求理解、供应商分析、询比价辅助、合同审阅和风险提示等产品能力。
• 将采购知识、业务规则、权限与合规边界转化为可执行的产品机制、知识库、Prompt、工具调用和工作流。
• 负责需求分析、产品方案、原型、PRD、技术协同、上线验证与持续迭代，对使用率和业务结果负责。
• 推动 AI 能力与采购、供应商、合同、财务及企业协同系统集成，建立人工确认、审计追踪、异常处理和权限控制机制。
• 建立效率、周期、准确率、采用率、成本节约和风险控制指标，通过数据持续优化。
• 协调采购、业务、产品、算法、研发、法务和财务团队，推动组织级变革落地。

任职要求：
• 具备采购域产品、供应链产品、B2B 交易平台、企业服务或复杂后台系统经验。
• 有完整产品生命周期和跨部门项目交付能力，能处理复杂流程、权限、数据和系统集成问题。
• 理解 LLM、Agent、RAG 和工作流自动化的能力边界，有 AI 产品或自动化项目落地经验优先。
• 熟悉采购、供应商管理、合同、订单、结算或供应链协同中的至少一个核心环节。
• 逻辑清晰、抽象能力强，能够将非标准人工经验沉淀为可规模化的系统能力。

参考人才背景（仅用于帮助理解画像，不构成定向挖猎名单）：
• 互联网大厂采购域或企业内部平台的产品经理。
• 供应链、B2B 交易、企业 SaaS、合同及供应商管理领域的产品经理。
descriptionEn:
Role Context:
Procurement spans intake, sourcing, supplier onboarding, RFx, contracting, acceptance, settlement, and risk. This role applies LLMs, agents, RAG, knowledge systems, and workflow automation to redesign the operating model—not merely add isolated tools or demos.

Responsibilities:
• Map the end-to-end procurement journey and identify high-value AI automation opportunities.
• Build procurement copilots and agents for intelligent sourcing, requirement understanding, supplier analysis, RFx support, contract review, and risk signals.
• Translate procurement knowledge, rules, permissions, and compliance boundaries into product mechanisms, prompts, tools, and workflows.
• Own discovery, product design, prototypes, specifications, engineering delivery, adoption, and iteration.
• Integrate AI with procurement, supplier, contract, finance, and collaboration systems, including human approval, auditability, exception handling, and access controls.
• Measure cycle time, accuracy, adoption, savings, and risk outcomes.

Requirements:
Experience in procurement products, supply chain, B2B transactions, enterprise SaaS, or complex internal platforms; strong end-to-end product delivery and systems thinking; familiarity with LLM, agent, RAG, or workflow automation; and the ability to convert non-standard operational expertise into scalable product capabilities.

Reference backgrounds only—not a targeted poaching list: procurement-domain product managers at large internet companies, or product leaders from supply-chain, B2B transaction, enterprise SaaS, contract, and supplier-management platforms.

title: 大模型训练数据采购专家
workMode: 杭州办公；资深专家职级，计划招聘 2–3 人
description:
岗位背景：
大模型训练、微调与评测需要持续获得合法合规、质量稳定、覆盖充分的数据。本岗位负责标准化数据集与定制化语料的采购，将算法团队的训练目标转化为可采购、可验收、可复用的数据规格，并建立覆盖资源发现、商务合作、合规审查、质量验收和长期供应的完整体系。

岗位职责：
• 负责文本、图像、音频、视频及行业数据等标准化数据集和定制化语料的寻源、采购与交付。
• 与模型、算法和评测团队协作，将训练、微调、对齐与评测需求拆解为语言、领域、模态、规模、质量、时效、授权和验收标准。
• 开拓并管理数据交易所、数据服务商、行业机构、内容与版权资源方等多元供应渠道。
• 负责供应商尽调、方案比选、商务谈判、合同、交付、验收、结算和持续质量管理。
• 与法务、安全和数据治理团队协作，审核数据来源、权属授权、个人信息、隐私保护、跨境及使用范围，降低合规风险。
• 建立数据资源目录、供应商池、价格基准、质量记录与复用机制，提升数据采购效率和资产沉淀。
• 识别供给缺口和交付风险，推动定制采集、加工、标注或替代方案落地。

任职要求：
• 具备数据评测、数据采购、数据 BD、数据资源运营、数据服务或训练数据项目经验。
• 理解大模型训练、微调、对齐或评测中的数据需求，能够将算法目标转化为数据规格和验收标准。
• 具备出色的资源开拓、商务谈判、项目管理和跨团队沟通能力。
• 对数据质量、版权、授权、个人信息保护和数据合规具有较强意识。
• 有多模态数据、行业语料、跨语言数据、公共数据或大型定制数据项目经验者优先。

参考人才背景（仅用于帮助理解画像，不构成定向挖猎名单）：
• 互联网大厂的数据评测、数据 BD、数据资源运营、训练数据或数据治理岗位。
• 国央企数据服务商、各省市数据交易所及类似库帕斯的数据资源服务机构。
descriptionEn:
Role Context:
Training, fine-tuning, alignment, and evaluation require legally sourced, reliable, representative data. This role sources standardized datasets and customized corpora, translates model objectives into procurable and testable specifications, and builds the full system from resource discovery and commercial partnership through compliance, quality acceptance, and long-term supply.

Responsibilities:
• Source and procure standardized and custom text, image, audio, video, and industry datasets.
• Translate training, fine-tuning, alignment, and evaluation needs into language, domain, modality, scale, quality, licensing, and acceptance specifications.
• Develop supply channels across data exchanges, data-service companies, industry institutions, and content or rights holders.
• Own supplier diligence, evaluation, negotiation, contracting, delivery, acceptance, settlement, and quality management.
• Partner with Legal, Security, and Data Governance on provenance, rights, privacy, cross-border considerations, and permitted use.
• Build resource catalogs, supplier pools, pricing benchmarks, quality histories, and reuse mechanisms.
• Resolve supply gaps through custom collection, processing, annotation, or alternative solutions.

Requirements:
Experience in data evaluation, data procurement, data BD, data-resource operations, data services, or training-data programs; practical understanding of model-training and evaluation data; strong sourcing, negotiation, delivery, and compliance judgment. Multimodal, multilingual, industry-corpus, public-data, or large custom-data experience is preferred.

Reference backgrounds only—not a targeted poaching list: data evaluation, data BD, resource operations, training-data, or governance roles at major internet companies; and state-owned data-service providers, provincial or municipal data exchanges, and comparable data-resource institutions.

title: 首席营销官（CMO）
workMode: San Carlos 办公；全球市场一号位；不设置特定语言硬性门槛
workModeEn: San Carlos-based; global marketing executive; no specific language requirement
description:
岗位介绍：
公司已经完成从产品验证到高速规模化的关键跨越：拥有超过 800 万月活用户、超过 7,000 万美元 ARR、成熟的全球订阅商业模式，以及覆盖图像、视频、角色、音频和完整故事创作的产品矩阵。现在需要一位兼具消费市场判断、品牌建设、增长能力与组织领导经验的 CMO，把已有的产品势能转化为长期全球品牌、创作者生态和可持续增长体系。

这不是只负责品牌传播或投放放量的传统市场岗位。你将与创始团队紧密合作，统一品牌、产品营销、增长、内容、创作者生态、社区、PR 与商业化叙事，并对全球市场策略及结果负责。

岗位职责：
• 制定全球营销战略、品牌定位和年度增长路线图，明确重点人群、市场、渠道与资源配置。
• 建立具有全球辨识度的 AI 创作品牌，提炼从图像工具走向完整视觉叙事平台的核心叙事与品类心智。
• 统筹产品营销和 GTM，负责重要产品、模型能力和创作体验的定位、发布、市场教育及采用增长。
• 建设全漏斗增长体系，打通品牌、内容、SEO/GEO、社媒、创作者、社区、合作伙伴、生命周期运营和效果增长。
• 搭建并扩大创作者生态，与艺术家、设计师、电影人、AI 创作者、教育者及专业内容团队建立长期合作机制。
• 建设全球内容与社交传播体系，将用户作品、角色、故事和创作方法转化为可持续的品牌资产与自然增长动力。
• 主导 PR、行业影响力、重点活动和文化事件，在 AI、创意工具、影视与创作者经济领域建立话语权。
• 深入研究用户分层、激活、留存、付费和 LTV，与产品、数据和商业团队共同优化订阅转化及商业化效率。
• 建立营销数据与实验体系，对品牌认知、用户增长、获客效率、留存、收入贡献及市场 ROI 负责。
• 从零到一搭建高密度全球市场团队，明确组织结构、人才标准、协作机制和外部伙伴体系。

核心画像：
• 必须具备真实的 To C 市场经验和品牌建设能力。两项都强是最理想画像；其中一项略弱可以讨论，但两项都缺失不适合该岗位。
• 行业背景开放，不限定科技公司。除消费科技、AI、内容与创意工具外，也欢迎来自时尚、美妆、饮料、消费品、生活方式、娱乐文化或其他优秀 To C 品牌的人选。
• 需要既懂如何建立消费者心智、品牌叙事与文化影响力，也能把品牌工作连接到用户增长、产品采用、留存和商业结果。
• 纯效果投放、纯 B2B 产品营销，或缺少消费者品牌建设案例的人选不属于核心目标。

任职要求：
• 8 年以上 To C 品牌、市场或增长经验，并有负责全球市场、区域市场或核心业务的经历。
• 有从早期阶段建立或重塑消费品牌，并推动其走向规模化增长的完整案例；能够清楚说明关键决策、传播策略、渠道组合、增长曲线和失败经验。
• 具备优秀的品牌战略、消费者洞察、创意判断与叙事能力，同时能通过数据、实验和业务指标衡量市场工作的真实影响。
• 产品感强，能够快速理解 AI 模型、创作工作流和用户行为，并与产品、设计、算法及工程团队共同定义市场机会。
• 熟悉创作者生态、UGC、社交内容、社区增长或文化型品牌建设，能够建立真实而非一次性的创作者关系。
• 具备预算管理、组织搭建和跨职能领导能力，能在精干团队与高速迭代环境中亲自下场并推动结果。
• 具备高管级沟通与跨文化协作能力；本岗位不设置特定语言硬性门槛。

加分项：
• 有 AI 原生消费产品、生成式内容、设计/视频工具或创作者平台经验。
• 有全球订阅产品、PLG、SEO/GEO、Creator-led Growth 或社区驱动增长经验。
• 建立过新消费品牌品类、全球创作者计划、重大产品发布或具有行业影响力的文化事件。
• 对视觉创作、故事叙事、电影、设计、时尚或消费文化有长期兴趣与个人判断。

岗位亮点：
• 产品市场契合与商业模式已经得到验证，CMO 可以直接在强势基本盘上建设全球品牌。
• 超过 800 万月活用户和超过 7,000 万美元 ARR，为品牌、社区与增长实验提供真实规模。
• 产品横跨图像、视频、角色、音频和完整故事，具备定义下一代 AI 创作平台品类的机会。
• 与创始团队直接合作，拥有全球营销战略、团队和预算的完整责任与影响力。
descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
The company has crossed the critical threshold from product validation to rapid scale, with more than eight million monthly active users, over US$70 million in ARR, a proven global subscription model, and a creative suite spanning image, video, characters, audio, and end-to-end storytelling. It is now looking for a CMO who combines consumer judgment, brand building, growth leadership, and organizational leadership to convert strong product momentum into an enduring global brand, creator ecosystem, and scalable growth engine.

This is not a conventional brand-communications or paid-acquisition role. Working closely with the founders, you will unify Brand, Product Marketing, Growth, Content, Creator Ecosystem, Community, PR, and monetization narratives while owning global market strategy and outcomes.

What You Will Do:
• Define global marketing strategy, brand positioning, annual growth priorities, audience strategy, market sequencing, and resource allocation.
• Build a distinctive global AI-creation brand and establish the category narrative from image tools to a complete visual-storytelling platform.
• Own product marketing and GTM for major products, model capabilities, and new creative experiences.
• Build a full-funnel growth system across brand, content, SEO/GEO, social, creators, community, partnerships, lifecycle, and performance growth.
• Scale a creator ecosystem across artists, designers, filmmakers, AI creators, educators, and professional content teams.
• Turn user creations, characters, stories, and workflows into durable brand assets and organic distribution.
• Lead PR, industry influence, flagship events, and cultural moments across AI, creative tools, entertainment, and the creator economy.
• Partner with Product, Data, and Commercial teams on segmentation, activation, retention, paid conversion, LTV, and subscription economics.
• Establish measurement and experimentation systems across brand awareness, user growth, acquisition efficiency, retention, revenue contribution, and ROI.
• Build a high-density global marketing organization, including structure, talent standards, operating rhythms, and agency or partner ecosystems.

Core Profile:
• Genuine B2C marketing experience and proven brand-building capability are both required. The ideal candidate is strong in both; one dimension may be somewhat lighter, but candidates missing both are not a fit.
• Industry background is intentionally broad. In addition to consumer technology, AI, content, and creative tools, strong candidates may come from fashion, beauty, beverages, consumer goods, lifestyle, entertainment, or other high-quality B2C brands.
• You must know how to build consumer mindshare, brand narrative, and cultural relevance while connecting brand investment to adoption, retention, growth, and commercial outcomes.
• Pure performance-marketing specialists, purely B2B product marketers, or candidates without credible consumer-brand work are not the primary profile.

What We Look For:
• 8+ years in B2C brand, marketing, or growth, including ownership of a global market, regional market, or major business line.
• A complete record of building or repositioning a consumer brand from an early stage and helping take it to scale, with clear command of key decisions, communications strategy, channel mix, growth curves, and failed experiments.
• Outstanding brand strategy, consumer insight, creative judgment, and storytelling, paired with the ability to measure market impact through data, experiments, and business outcomes.
• Strong product judgment and the ability to understand AI capabilities, creative workflows, and user behavior deeply enough to shape opportunities with Product, Design, AI, and Engineering.
• Experience with creator ecosystems, UGC, social content, community-led growth, or culture-driven brands.
• Budget ownership, organization building, and cross-functional leadership, with the willingness to remain hands-on in a lean, fast-moving environment.
• Executive communication and cross-cultural effectiveness. No specific language is required.

Preferred:
AI-native consumer products, generative content, design or video tools, creator platforms, global subscriptions, PLG, SEO/GEO, creator-led growth, community growth, category creation, major launches, or personal depth in visual storytelling, design, fashion, and consumer culture.

Why Join:
Build a global brand on top of proven product-market fit, more than eight million MAU, and over US$70 million in ARR. Shape the category for a platform spanning image, video, characters, audio, and complete storytelling, with direct founder partnership and meaningful ownership of strategy, team, and budget.

description:
岗位介绍：
加入一家处于早期核心阶段的新一代 AGI 模型公司，把前沿模型能力转化为大众愿意理解、讨论和传播的故事。这个岗位既需要真正关注 AI 技术变化，也需要理解社交媒体的内容机制、传播路径和意见领袖生态。

岗位职责：
• 持续追踪大模型与 Agent 领域的前沿进展、行业动向和社交传播路径，分析话题如何被点燃、由谁推动以及为何出圈。
• 将复杂的技术突破和产品能力翻译成清晰、有记忆点且有传播力的叙事，围绕产品发布与日常运营制定内容和传播策略。
• 深入理解小红书、公众号等国内平台以及主流海外社交平台的内容调性、算法逻辑、用户习惯和传播机制。
• 针对不同平台完成差异化选题、内容表达、发布节奏和互动设计，而不是简单复制同一套素材。
• 挖掘、触达并维护国内外技术达人、KOL 和行业创作者，推动合作、内容共创与长期关系建设。
• 复盘内容表现、达人合作和传播链路，沉淀可复用的选题判断、叙事框架和运营方法。

任职要求：
• 对前沿 AI、大模型与 Agent 有真实理解和长期热情，能够判断内容时机与传播机会；重度使用前沿 AI 工具者优先。
• 具备传播叙事和策略能力，能够把复杂技术讲成不同受众愿意理解和转发的内容。
• 至少具备一个社交媒体平台的实际运营经验，有可说明的内容或增长案例。
• 对热点、社区氛围、内容审美和传播节奏敏感，兼具独立判断与快速执行能力。

加分项：
• 有技术达人或 KOL 挖掘、触达、合作与内容共创经验。
• 海外方向候选人具备海外学习、工作或生活经历，英语可作为工作语言。
• 能独立使用 AI 工具创作具有传播力的图文、视频或互动内容。
• 有大模型、AI 产业媒体或前沿科技内容经历。

岗位亮点：
• 直接参与新一代 AGI 模型公司的品牌与传播体系从 0 到 1。
• 深度接触模型研究、Agent 产品和开发者生态，不是外围品牌执行岗位。
• 国内与海外传播方向均有空间，能够建立跨平台、跨文化的技术叙事能力。
descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Join an early-stage next-generation AGI model company and turn frontier model capabilities into stories that people can understand, discuss, and share. This role requires both genuine curiosity about AI progress and strong judgment about social platforms, narratives, and opinion-leader ecosystems.

What You Will Do:
• Track frontier developments across LLMs and agents, studying how technical topics spread, who ignites them, and why they break through.
• Translate complex technical and product capabilities into clear, memorable narratives for launches and always-on communications.
• Develop platform-native strategies across major Chinese and global social channels, adapting topics, formats, timing, and interaction mechanics to each audience.
• Identify, engage, and build relationships with technical creators and KOLs in China and overseas, driving partnerships and content co-creation.
• Analyze content, creator collaborations, and propagation paths to build repeatable editorial and distribution playbooks.

What We Look For:
• Genuine understanding of and passion for frontier AI, LLMs, and agents; heavy users of advanced AI tools are preferred.
• Strong narrative and communications judgment, with the ability to make complex technology accessible without losing substance.
• Hands-on operating experience on at least one social platform and clear examples of content or growth outcomes.
• Strong sensitivity to trends, community dynamics, content quality, and timing.

Preferred:
Technical creator/KOL partnerships; overseas study, work, or living experience and professional English for the global track; AI-assisted content creation; or experience in AI and technology media.

workMode: 北京、深圳或上海办公

location: 北京 / 深圳 / 上海
description:
岗位介绍：
这是一个极具拓荒性质的核心产品岗位。你将负责定义前沿模型能力与真实用户任务之间的最佳接口，推动 Agent Harness 与模型共同进化，让智能体能够可靠地进入研究、创作、决策、协作和执行等复杂工作流。我们寻找的不是传统写 PRD 的产品经理，而是既能深入框架源码、理解模型行为，又能敏锐捕捉开发者与高价值用户痛点的技术型产品负责人。

岗位职责：
• 规划 Agent Harness 产品的演进路线，跳出现有框架局限，基于多步复杂任务执行轨迹定义下一代产品壁垒与交互形态。
• 与模型研究和工程团队紧密协作，从 Harness 视角推动模型能力适配，将技术突破转化为稳定、可验证的真实体验。
• 深入真实高价值场景定义任务与成功标准，不盲目追求基准跑分，而是衡量 Agent 是否真正解决用户问题。
• 分析开源社区、开发者和用户社群中的高噪反馈，提取高价值信号并推动产品敏捷迭代。
• 建立覆盖任务轨迹、成功率、质量、成本、延迟和体验的数据验证机制。
• 使用 AI Coding 快速完成原型、技术验证与 UI/UX 交互方案，推动从洞察到上线的完整闭环。

任职要求：
• 3 年以上相关经验；特别优秀者不受年限限制。逻辑清晰、技术视野广，能在高复杂度和高不确定性中闭环推进。
• 是 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent 工具的高强度用户，对模型行为和开发者体验有高标准。
• 软件开发基础扎实，能使用 AI Agent 工具完成高质量编程，并快速进入陌生技术栈。
• 有能力阅读、拆解并逆向分析主流 Agent 框架源码，理解其架构、执行链路与关键取舍。
• 熟悉 LLM API、KV Cache、Agent Loop、Tool Use、Reasoning、Planning、MCP、Memory 等核心机制。
• 对 Prompt、Context 与 Harness Engineering 有成体系的实践经验。
• 具备数据与设计素养，能建立验证机制并独立完成产品原型和体验设计。
• 能用中英文与全球开源生态沟通，并把复杂技术理念转化为团队共识。

加分项：
• 有一人公司或小团队 0 到 1 产品闭环经验。
• 拥有高质量开源作品，或在主流开源社区有代码级贡献。
• 与顶尖 AI 研究人员有深度协作经验，具备优秀科研品味。
• 在计算机、数据科学相关赛事获奖，或发表过高水平论文。

岗位亮点：
• 负责模型公司最接近真实用户价值的 Agent 核心方向，而非外围应用。
• 与模型研究团队共同定义能力边界、训练反馈与产品形态。
• 早期负责人席位，对技术路线、产品体验和开发者生态拥有真实影响力。
descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
This is a highly exploratory core product role defining the best interface between frontier model capabilities and real user tasks. You will co-evolve Agent Harness infrastructure with model research so agents can reliably operate across complex workflows in research, creation, decision-making, collaboration, and execution. This is not a conventional PRD-only PM role; it requires source-level technical depth, strong judgment about model behavior, and exceptional sensitivity to developer and high-value user needs.

What You Will Do:
• Own the Agent Harness roadmap and define next-generation product moats and interactions through deep analysis of multi-step task trajectories.
• Partner closely with model researchers and engineers to adapt Harness and model capabilities together, translating breakthroughs into reliable user outcomes.
• Define real-world tasks and success criteria, prioritizing actual user value over benchmark scores.
• Distill high-value signals from noisy open-source, developer, and user feedback.
• Build measurement across task trajectories, success, quality, cost, latency, and experience.
• Use AI Coding to prototype, validate technical ideas, and design interaction flows from insight through launch.

What We Look For:
• 3+ years of relevant experience, with exceptions for outstanding candidates; strong systems thinking and execution in ambiguity.
• Heavy use of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar agent tools, with high standards for model behavior and developer experience.
• Strong software foundations and the ability to enter unfamiliar stacks quickly with AI assistance.
• Ability to inspect and reverse-engineer mainstream agent frameworks at the source-code level.
• Practical command of LLM APIs, KV Cache, Agent Loops, Tool Use, Reasoning, Planning, MCP, Memory, Prompt, Context, and Harness Engineering.
• Strong data and design judgment, including validation systems and independent UI/UX prototyping.
• Ability to communicate with the global open-source ecosystem in Chinese and English.

Preferred:
One-person-company or zero-to-one small-team experience, meaningful open-source contributions, collaboration with leading AI researchers, or strong competition and publication credentials.

profile.experience: 3年以上；特别优秀者不限年限

title: AI Native 产品与品牌设计师
workMode: 北京办公；首位设计师 / Founding Designer
description:
岗位介绍：
作为公司的首位设计师，你定义的不是单个项目，而是一家新一代 AGI 模型公司被世界感知和理解的方式。你将同时主导品牌视觉与 AI 产品体验，从 0 到 1 建立视觉语言，并探索如何让复杂的模型和 Agent 能力以自然、优雅且有辨识度的方式进入用户工作流。

岗位职责：
• 定义并持续演进公司的审美标准和完整视觉体系，覆盖品牌形象、官网、发布物料、社交内容、周边与线下触点。
• 负责 AI 产品的 UI/UX、视觉和交互设计，让前沿模型能力以清晰、可信和高品质的方式服务用户。
• 将复杂技术、产品能力与公司愿景转化为有感染力的视觉叙事。
• 与创始团队、产品、模型研究和工程团队深度协作，在早期阶段共同定义产品形态。
• 重度使用 AIGC 与 Agent 工具提高研究、概念生成、原型、视觉生产和交付效率。
• 探索尚未被充分定义的 AI Native 交互和品牌表达方式，持续建立可复用的设计系统与方法。

任职要求：
• 设计、美术教育、游戏设计或相关专业本科及以上学历。
• 在国内外中大型科技公司具备完整的产品 UI/UX 与平面、品牌或视觉设计经验。
• 审美和原创能力出众，能够从 0 到 1 定义一套有辨识度且可扩展的视觉语言。
• 在熟练使用传统设计工具的基础上，至少有一年重度使用 AIGC 工具进行文字、图像或视频生产的经验。
• 熟悉 Claude Cowork、Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes Agent 或同类 AI Native 工具，并能把工具真正融入设计工作流。
• 热爱 AI 技术，相信 AI 将成为新时代的核心生产力，并愿意长期探索其产品与设计范式。
• 拥有高质量作品集，能够清晰说明作品背后的判断、取舍和系统性思考。

岗位亮点：
• 公司的第一位设计师，能够从源头定义品牌、产品与设计系统。
• 与模型研究及 Agent 产品团队直接协作，把前沿能力转化为真实体验。
• 不局限于执行既定需求，而是参与公司审美标准、产品方向与全球表达的共同建设。
descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
As the company's first designer, you will define not just a project but how a next-generation AGI model company is perceived and understood. You will lead both brand expression and AI product experience, building a visual language from zero and exploring how complex model and agent capabilities can enter real workflows with clarity, elegance, and distinction.

What You Will Do:
• Define and evolve the company's visual standards across brand identity, website, launches, social content, merchandise, and physical touchpoints.
• Own UI/UX, visual, and interaction design for AI products, making frontier capabilities clear, trustworthy, and delightful.
• Translate complex technology, product value, and company vision into compelling visual narratives.
• Partner deeply with founders, Product, model research, and Engineering to shape early product direction.
• Use AIGC and agent tools throughout research, concepting, prototyping, visual production, and delivery.
• Explore new AI-native interaction and brand patterns while building reusable design systems.

What We Look For:
• Bachelor's degree or above in Design, Art Education, Game Design, or a related field.
• Complete product UI/UX plus graphic, visual, or brand design experience at a mid-sized or large technology company in China or overseas.
• Outstanding taste and originality, with the ability to create a distinctive and scalable visual language from zero.
• At least one year of intensive AIGC use across text, image, or video production in addition to strong traditional design skills.
• Fluency with Claude Cowork, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, or comparable AI-native tools as part of a real design workflow.
• Deep enthusiasm for AI and a high-quality portfolio supported by clear, systematic design reasoning.

Why Join:
Become the first designer with direct influence over brand, product, and design systems, working alongside model research and Agent product teams to translate frontier intelligence into real user experiences.

profile.experience: 完整产品 UI/UX 与品牌视觉经验；至少 1 年重度 AIGC 实践
profile.experienceEn: End-to-end UI/UX and brand experience; 1+ year of intensive AIGC practice

title: 海外增长负责人（C端 AI 产品）
titleEn: Founding Overseas Growth Lead, Consumer AI
workMode: 北京办公；海外第一位增长核心；汇报运营负责人
workModeEn: Beijing-based; first overseas growth hire; reports to the Head of Operations
description:
岗位定位：
这是海外市场的第一位增长核心岗位，不是单一社媒、达人或投放执行岗。产品已具备可演示版本，国内已有产品、技术和运营团队支持，但海外尚未建立完整增长体系。你将汇报运营负责人，端到端负责一款 C 端 AI 产品的海外 0 到 1：市场选择、产品定位、内容与社媒、KOL/KOC、付费投放、激活转化、留存和商业化，并逐步搭建团队。

岗位职责：
1. 海外市场选择与增长战略
• 结合产品能力、定价、用户需求、竞争格局和渠道成本，在北美、欧洲、东南亚、拉美等市场中确定优先级。
• 定义目标用户、核心价值叙事、阶段目标、增长路线图、预算和测试淘汰标准。

2. 端到端增长闭环
• 对新增、激活、DAU/MAU、D1/D7/D30 留存、付费转化、CAC、LTV、ROI 和续费等核心指标负责。
• 与产品团队共同优化 onboarding、Aha Moment、功能教育、生命周期触达和付费路径，而非只负责流量获取。

3. 内容、社媒与自然增长
• 从 0 搭建 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Facebook、X、Reddit 等内容与社媒体系。
• 根据目标市场制定本地化内容策略，早期能够亲自完成选题、测试、复盘与冷启动，沉淀可复制的方法。

4. 达人、社区与渠道合作
• 搭建海外 KOL/KOC、垂直社区、测评媒体和合作渠道体系。
• 设计达人分层、合作模式、激励机制和评估标准，将零散合作逐步转化为可规模化增长渠道。

5. 付费增长与实验体系
• 负责或深度参与 Google、Meta、TikTok 等渠道的投放策略、素材、人群、出价和落地页优化。
• 以小预算快速验证假设，建立归因、漏斗和实验机制，找到可持续放大的增长组合。

6. 产品本地化与跨团队协同
• 基于海外用户反馈推动产品功能、定价、语言、支付与体验本地化。
• 与国内产品、研发、设计和运营团队紧密协作，将市场信号快速转化为产品迭代与增长动作。

7. 团队建设
• 早期亲自下场完成关键工作，并根据业务验证结果逐步招募和培养社媒、达人、投放等方向成员。
• 建立清晰的目标、节奏、复盘和协作机制，形成可复制的海外增长能力。

任职要求：
• 3 年以上海外增长相关经验，必须独立负责过 C 端产品海外从 0 到 1，而非仅参与单一模块。
• 能独立完成市场选择、用户定位、渠道组合、预算分配和实验设计，至少有一个从冷启动走向初步规模的真实案例。
• 具备完整增长视角，覆盖社媒内容、达人合作、付费投放、激活转化、留存与商业化中的多个环节。
• 数据能力扎实，能够围绕 CAC、LTV、留存、付费转化和 ROI 发现问题并推动优化。
• 英语可作为工作语言，能够独立进行海外内容判断、用户研究、达人及合作伙伴沟通。
• 成熟、务实、结果导向，能在高不确定性和资源有限的环境中做判断、亲自验证并承担最终结果。
• 不依赖成熟团队、大预算或代理商才开展工作，既能制定策略，也愿意深入执行细节。

加分项：
• 有 AI 助手、AI Companion、AI 工具、效率工具、内容产品或订阅制 App 的海外增长经验。
• 同时具备产品增长、社媒/达人与效果广告能力。
• 有北美、欧洲、东南亚或拉美市场的真实操盘经验。
• 有低成本增长、爆款内容、达人规模化或自然增长成功案例。
• 有早期创业公司、新业务或从 0 搭建小型增长团队的经验。

不太匹配的情况：
• 仅做社媒发帖、达人执行、品牌传播或纯买量中的单一环节。
• 没有完整 C 端产品海外 0 到 1 经验。
• 习惯在成熟团队、充分预算和固定流程下工作，缺少亲自验证与闭环能力。
descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
This is the first core overseas growth hire, not a single-channel social, creator, or performance-marketing role. With a working product demo and Product, Engineering, and Operations support in China, you will build the international growth system from zero. Reporting to the Head of Operations, you will own market selection, positioning, content and social, creators, paid acquisition, activation, retention, monetization, and the gradual build-out of the growth team for a consumer AI product.

Responsibilities:
• Prioritize markets across North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Latin America based on user demand, competition, pricing, product fit, and channel economics.
• Define target users, positioning, growth roadmap, budget, and test criteria.
• Own new users, activation, DAU/MAU, D1/D7/D30 retention, paid conversion, CAC, LTV, ROI, and renewal outcomes.
• Partner with Product to improve onboarding, the aha moment, feature education, lifecycle engagement, and monetization.
• Build organic growth across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X, Reddit, and relevant communities, remaining hands-on during cold start.
• Build scalable KOL/KOC, community, review-media, and partner channels with clear segmentation, incentives, and measurement.
• Own or deeply partner on Google, Meta, and TikTok acquisition, including creative, audience, bidding, landing pages, attribution, funnels, and rapid experimentation.
• Turn international user signals into product, pricing, language, payment, and experience localization with teams in China.
• Build the team gradually after validating repeatable channels and operating rhythms.

Requirements:
• 3+ years in international growth, including direct ownership of a consumer product's overseas zero-to-one journey.
• A real example of taking a product from cold start to early scale, with ownership of market choice, user positioning, channel mix, budget, and experiments.
• Full-funnel capability spanning multiple areas across social content, creators, paid acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization.
• Strong command of CAC, LTV, retention, paid conversion, and ROI.
• Professional English for content judgment, research, creator partnerships, and business communication.
• Mature, practical, hands-on, and accountable in ambiguity and resource-constrained environments.

Preferred:
International growth experience in AI assistants, AI companions, AI tools, productivity, content, or subscription apps; product-growth plus creator and performance capability; direct experience in key global regions; low-cost growth or breakout-content cases; or early-stage team-building experience.

Not a Fit:
Single-channel social posting, creator execution, brand-only work, or pure media buying without full-funnel ownership; no consumer overseas zero-to-one experience; or reliance on mature teams, large budgets, agencies, and established processes.

profile.experience: 3年以上；必须独立负责过海外 C 端产品 0 到 1
profile.experienceEn: 3+ years with direct ownership of a consumer product's overseas zero-to-one journey

title: VIP 与机构产品负责人
workMode: 亚太地区；优先香港、新加坡；支持香港签证；带领约 10 人以内团队
workModeEn: APAC; Hong Kong or Singapore preferred; Hong Kong visa support; leads a team of under 10
location: 香港 / 新加坡 / 亚太地区
description:
岗位定位：
负责全球数字金融平台的 VIP 与机构产品体系，覆盖面向用户的产品体验、管理后台和底层能力。当前机构侧基础设施相对完整，核心挑战是把高净值用户的分层、权益感知、使用路径和整体体验提升到下一阶段，并推动产品团队从被动接需求转向主动定义战略与路线图。岗位直接汇报产品一号位，并与前台业务负责人紧密协作。

岗位职责：
• 制定 VIP 与机构产品战略及路线图，覆盖 VIP 等级、权益与激励计划、机构服务、OTC/RFQ、CRM 和相关平台能力。
• 重点优化 C 端高净值用户体验，让不同层级用户清楚理解身份、权益、可使用产品与升级路径。
• 深入高净值及机构客户场景，把业务、客户和监管需求转化为可扩展的产品体系，而非仅承接零散需求。
• 主动向业务团队提供用户洞察、产品机会和优先级判断，提升产品在业务决策中的战略价值。
• 端到端推进关键功能，从需求发现、PRD、设计和研发协作到上线、数据验证与持续迭代。
• 带领并辅导约 10 人以内的产品团队，同时亲自负责关键模块，以实践建立产品标准和团队信任。
• 协调产品、工程、设计、合规、运营、BD 与市场等多方，处理节奏快、目标复杂的跨职能协作。

任职要求：
• 7 年以上产品经验，拥有 VIP、高净值客户、机构客户、财富管理、券商或金融交易产品相关经历。
• 优先考虑数字资产交易平台的 VIP 或机构产品经验；传统券商、银行、财富管理背景亦可，但需真正理解并认可数字金融行业。
• 兼具战略思维与扎实执行力，既能定义高层路线图，也能亲自写 PRD、推进项目并完成上线闭环。
• 对用户分层、权益体系、会员体验、机构工作流和金融产品体验有系统性理解。
• 有团队管理或资深产品带教经验，能够辅导成员并提升整体产品判断。
• 中英文均可作为工作语言，能够主持英文会议、即时讨论并独立完成英文文档。
• 具备国际化产品视野和跨文化沟通经验，能够服务全球客户并协调不同地区团队。
• 情商高、能量充足、响应迅速，能够与不同风格且要求较高的业务和产品负责人建立有效合作。
• 适应快速迭代和仍在完善中的基础设施，愿意亲自解决问题，不依赖完美流程。

加分项：
• 在头部数字资产、国际券商、私人银行或高端财富平台负责过相关产品。
• 有从 0 到 1 建设 VIP 权益体系、机构平台、CRM 或金融客户分层产品的经历。
• 有海外工作、留学或长期服务国际客户的背景。
descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Lead VIP and institutional products for a global digital-finance platform across customer-facing experiences, internal consoles, and platform capabilities. Institutional infrastructure is relatively mature; the immediate opportunity is to materially improve segmentation, benefit visibility, navigation, and overall experience for high-net-worth customers while moving the Product team from reactive requirement intake to proactive strategy and roadmap ownership. The role reports to the head of Product and partners closely with a senior front-office business leader.

Responsibilities:
• Define strategy and roadmap across VIP tiers, benefits and incentives, institutional services, OTC/RFQ, CRM, and supporting platform capabilities.
• Improve the end-to-end experience for high-net-worth customers so each segment clearly understands its status, benefits, available products, and progression path.
• Translate customer, business, and regulatory needs into scalable product systems rather than isolated features.
• Proactively bring user insights, product opportunities, and prioritization to business leaders.
• Own critical products from discovery and PRDs through design, engineering, launch, measurement, and iteration.
• Lead and coach a product team of fewer than 10 while remaining hands-on with key modules.
• Align Product, Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, BD, and Marketing in a fast-moving environment.

Requirements:
• 7+ years in Product with relevant experience across VIP, high-net-worth, institutional, wealth-management, brokerage, or financial-trading products.
• Digital-asset VIP or institutional experience is strongly preferred; candidates from brokerage, banking, or wealth management must bring genuine digital-finance understanding and motivation.
• Strong strategic thinking plus hands-on execution from PRD through launch.
• Systematic understanding of segmentation, benefits, membership experience, institutional workflows, and financial-product UX.
• Product leadership or coaching experience.
• Full professional fluency in both Chinese and English for live meetings and written communication.
• International product judgment, cross-cultural communication, high emotional intelligence, fast response, and comfort operating without perfect processes.

profile.experience: 7年以上产品经验；VIP、机构、财富管理或金融交易背景
profile.experienceEn: 7+ years in Product across VIP, institutional, wealth, or financial trading

description:
岗位定位：
负责全球金融交易产品的增长体系与团队，对产品自身的活跃和转化负责，而非公司层面的泛市场增长。岗位直接汇报产品一号位，将带领约 8 人团队，通过产品机制、用户洞察、数据实验和跨部门协作，持续提升 DAU、MAU、转化与留存。

岗位职责：
• 制定金融交易产品的增长战略、路线图与指标体系，围绕激活、活跃、转化、留存和用户价值建立完整增长闭环。
• 对 DAU、MAU、关键功能渗透、交易转化和留存等核心结果负责，识别漏斗瓶颈并确定优先级。
• 深入不同交易用户和生命周期阶段，设计 onboarding、功能教育、激励、召回、分层运营和关键路径优化方案。
• 建立数据分析与实验机制，通过用户分群、漏斗、留存和 A/B 测试验证增长假设并推动规模化。

• 带领约 8 人增长产品团队，明确目标和节奏，同时亲自推进关键项目与复杂问题。
• 在不完美的系统和流程中快速做判断、协调资源并推动结果，而非等待条件成熟。

任职要求：
• 7 年以上产品或产品增长经验，其中必须有金融、支付、证券交易或数字资产交易行业经历。
• 有明确的金融产品增长案例，能够说明如何通过产品机制提升 DAU、MAU、转化或留存。
• 具备扎实的数据分析、增长实验、漏斗设计和用户生命周期能力。
• 有团队管理经验，能够带领约 8 人团队，并保持对核心产品细节的直接参与。
• 中英文均可作为工作语言，能够参加全英文日会、即时讨论并独立输出英文会议纪要和产品文档。
• 国际化视野和跨文化协作能力强，能够在业务、工程与合规等多方之间建立共识。
• 成熟灵活、情商高、抗压且结果导向，能够面对强势利益相关方和快速变化的优先级。
• 接受仍在完善中的基础设施与流程，能够能上能下、亲自解决问题。

不太匹配的情况：
• 主要经验仅来自电商、直播或其他非金融 Web2 增长场景。
• 英文需要翻译工具才能完成会议讨论或文档输出。
• 依赖高度成熟、完全标准化的组织流程才能推动工作。
descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Own product-led growth for a global financial-trading product, with accountability for product activity and conversion rather than broad corporate marketing. Reporting to the head of Product, you will lead an approximately eight-person team and improve DAU, MAU, conversion, and retention through product mechanisms, user insight, experimentation, and cross-functional execution.

Responsibilities:
• Define growth strategy, roadmap, and measurement across activation, engagement, conversion, retention, and user value.
• Own DAU, MAU, feature adoption, trading conversion, and retention outcomes.
• Design onboarding, education, incentives, reactivation, segmentation, and critical-path improvements across trader lifecycles.
• Build a rigorous system of funnels, cohorts, retention analysis, and A/B testing.
• Partner with Trading, Product, Engineering, Data, Risk, Compliance, and Marketing to turn growth goals into shipped product changes.
• Lead an approximately eight-person team while remaining hands-on with critical initiatives.
• Make fast, pragmatic decisions and deliver results even when systems and processes are still evolving.

Requirements:
• 7+ years in Product or product growth, with mandatory experience in finance, payments, securities trading, or digital-asset trading.
• Demonstrated product-growth results across activity, conversion, and retention.
• Strong growth analytics, experimentation, funnel, and lifecycle capability.
• Team-management experience and willingness to stay close to product details.
• Full professional fluency in Chinese and English, including live discussions and written documentation without translation support.

description:

这是一家处于非常早期阶段的跨境 AI 公司，正在搭建面向真实世界应用的下一代智能基础设施。短期战略不是从机器人硬件切入，而是先建立计算机视觉、机器学习、多模态模型、垂直基础模型、大规模数据与评测系统的差异化能力，未来逐步演进至 Vision-Language-Action、具身智能与 Physical AI。

作为 Founding CTO，你将直接与 CEO 及创始团队合作，既定义公司的长期技术愿景，也在早期保持高度亲自参与。该岗位融合技术战略、AI 研发领导、团队建设、产品判断与融资支持，是公司的最高技术负责人和关键创始级合伙人。

核心职责：
• 定义并负责公司整体技术战略、技术路线图及阶段性优先级。
• 确立计算机视觉、机器学习、多模态 AI、基础模型、VLA 与未来具身智能系统的技术方向。
• 设计公司的模型、数据、评测、训练、部署与 AI 基础设施架构，建立高质量的数据—模型—评测闭环。
• 在团队规模尚小时亲自领导关键研究、原型与工程交付，把前沿研究转化为可扩展的商业产品。
• 识别并建设公司在模型、数据、系统与应用层最具防御性的技术壁垒。
• 从 0 招募并培养核心研究员和工程师，建立工程标准、技术文化、架构原则与高效执行机制。
• 与 CEO 共同参与产品战略、公司定位、合作伙伴关系和商业化路径设计。

• 领导旧金山湾区与上海团队的跨境协作，规划公司向 VLA、Embodied AI 与 Physical AI 演进的长期路径。

• 具备大规模数据、模型训练、评估、部署及 AI 基础设施的系统性理解。
• 有带领或搭建技术团队的经验，能够吸引、判断并激励优秀研究与工程人才。

descriptionEn:
About the Opportunity:
Join an early-stage cross-border AI company building next-generation intelligence for real-world applications. The initial strategy is not to begin with robot hardware, but to establish differentiated capabilities across computer vision, machine learning, multimodal models, vertical foundation models, large-scale data, and evaluation systems, with a long-term roadmap toward Vision-Language-Action, embodied intelligence, and Physical AI.

As Founding CTO, you will serve as the company's top technical leader and work directly with the CEO and founding team. You will define the long-term technical vision while remaining deeply hands-on during the early stage. The role combines technical strategy, AI leadership, team building, product judgment, commercialization, and fundraising support.

Key Responsibilities:
• Define and own the overall technology strategy, roadmap, and technical priorities.
• Set direction across computer vision, machine learning, multimodal AI, foundation models, VLA, and future embodied-intelligence systems.
• Architect the model, data, evaluation, training, deployment, and AI-infrastructure stack, creating a strong data-model-evaluation loop.
• Lead critical research, prototyping, and engineering delivery while the team remains small, translating frontier research into scalable commercial products.
• Identify and build the company's most defensible moat across models, data, systems, and applications.
• Recruit and develop the initial research and engineering organization and establish engineering standards, technical culture, architecture principles, and execution processes.
• Partner with the CEO on product strategy, company positioning, partnerships, and commercialization.
• Represent the technical vision to investors, strategic partners, customers, and future hires; support fundraising through a clear articulation of differentiation and defensibility.
• Lead collaboration across the San Francisco Bay Area and Shanghai and define the long-term roadmap toward VLA, Embodied AI, and Physical AI.

Ideal Profile:
• Ph.D. or Master's degree from a top university in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Robotics, or a related field is preferred.
• Strong, demonstrable depth in machine learning and computer vision, with experience in multimodal AI, VLMs, foundation models, VLA, robotics AI, autonomous systems, or adjacent areas.
• Proven ability to move sophisticated AI systems from research, data, and evaluation into production and commercial use.
• Strong understanding of large-scale data, training, evaluation, deployment, and AI infrastructure.
• Experience building or leading technical teams, with the ability to recruit and inspire exceptional researchers and engineers.
• Entrepreneurial judgment and comfort combining strategy, hands-on execution, and organization building under high ambiguity.
• Strong communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders and the ability to collaborate across the US and China.

Highly Relevant Backgrounds:
Talent from leading technology companies, AI labs, autonomous-driving companies, robotics companies, or successful AI startups is highly relevant. The most compelling profile combines top-tier academic training, leading AI industry experience, startup-building or zero-to-one execution, and team leadership. Candidates currently based in Silicon Valley are preferred, with a flexible approximately 50% US / 50% China setup possible. Both high-potential technical leaders and experienced founding/lead-level builders will be considered; ML/CV trajectory, leadership potential, and long-term commitment to VLA and Physical AI matter more than rigid years-of-experience thresholds.

What Success Looks Like:
• Establish a differentiated technical thesis and roadmap.
• Build the first generation of the AI platform and data-model-evaluation loop.
• Recruit the initial core technical team and establish a high-standard engineering culture.
• Build technical credibility with investors and strategic partners.
• Turn early technical capabilities into validated, scalable commercial applications.

Why Join:
This is a true founding-level opportunity with meaningful influence over technology, product, organization, and long-term direction. The role offers direct partnership with the CEO, ownership of the technical organization, exposure to investors and strategic partners, differentiated real-world data resources, a Silicon Valley + Shanghai platform, and significant founding-stage equity. Compensation includes a highly competitive US$300K–400K base plus meaningful equity/options, depending on experience, scope, and working arrangement.

岗位介绍：
加入一家成熟的全球内容社区平台 Trust & Safety 团队，建设下一代 AI Native 安全治理平台与系统，服务大规模全球内容与创作者生态。你将与工程、机器学习、政策和运营团队紧密合作，把复杂的审核、调查与风险决策流程转化为可规模化的 AI 平台能力。

岗位职责：
• 负责 AI Native Trust & Safety 平台的产品愿景、战略和路线图，打通风险感知、识别、审核、处置与评估的完整治理链路。
• 设计并推动 AI 驱动的安全治理平台和系统，支持自动化风险审核、风险分析、调查及辅助决策。
• 整合分散的审核工具、风控系统和运营流程，建设统一平台，提升治理效率、系统扩展性和风险可视化能力。
• 与工程、机器学习、政策及运营团队协作，将复杂治理需求转化为明确的平台产品能力、系统边界和交付路径。
• 建立平台质量、效率、准确率、覆盖率和风险处置效果等指标，通过数据与反馈持续迭代。

任职要求：
• 本科及以上学历，计算机、人工智能、数据科学或相关技术背景优先。
• 3 年以上 AI 平台、Trust & Safety 系统、风控平台或复杂数据平台产品经验。
• 熟悉大语言模型、Agent 架构或 AI 工作流自动化系统，能够判断模型能力、规则系统与人工流程的合理边界。
• 具备平台型产品设计能力，能够理解复杂系统架构、数据链路及运营流程。
• 跨团队推动能力强，能协调工程、算法、政策及运营团队完成产品落地。
• 中英文均可作为工作语言，能够适应全球团队及跨时区协作。

加分项：
• 有 Trust & Safety、审核平台、调查工具或风控平台建设经验。
• 与机器学习或 LLM 团队合作落地过生产级 AI 产品。
• 熟悉 Agent Orchestration、Prompt Engineering 或 AI 自动化框架。
• 有全球互联网平台或大规模 UGC 内容生态经验。

岗位信息：
• Base：Palo Alto, CA。
• 美国岗位可提供签证支持。
descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Join the Trust & Safety organization of an established global content-community platform and build the next generation of AI-native safety-governance systems for a large global creator and content ecosystem. You will partner with Engineering, Machine Learning, Policy, and Operations to turn complex moderation, investigation, and risk decisions into scalable AI platform capabilities.

Responsibilities:
• Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI-native Trust & Safety platform spanning risk sensing, detection, review, enforcement, and evaluation.
• Design AI-driven systems for automated review, risk analysis, investigations, and decision support.
• Consolidate fragmented moderation tools, risk systems, and operating workflows into a unified, scalable platform with stronger visibility.
• Translate complex governance requirements into clear platform capabilities, system boundaries, and delivery plans with Engineering, ML, Policy, and Operations.
• Define and improve metrics across platform quality, efficiency, accuracy, coverage, and enforcement outcomes.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or above; a technical background in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
• 3+ years in AI platforms, Trust & Safety systems, risk platforms, or complex data-platform Product roles.
• Familiarity with LLMs, Agent architectures, or AI workflow automation.
• Strong platform-product judgment and the ability to understand system architecture, data flows, and operational processes.
• Excellent cross-functional execution across Engineering, ML, Policy, and Operations.
• Professional fluency in both Chinese and English is required.

Preferred:
Trust & Safety, moderation, investigation, or risk-platform experience; production AI products built with ML/LLM teams; Agent orchestration, prompt engineering, or automation frameworks; global internet or large-scale UGC experience.

Location: Palo Alto, CA. US visa sponsorship is available.

descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Own user trust and transparency products within the Trust & Safety organization of a global content-community platform. You will design user-facing governance experiences that explain moderation decisions, enforcement outcomes, appeals, reporting mechanisms, and platform rules in ways that feel clear, fair, and understandable.

Responsibilities:
• Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for user trust and transparency capabilities.
• Design clear governance communication that helps users understand moderation outcomes, enforcement reasons, and applicable rules.
• Build and improve appeals, reporting, and feedback systems to increase operational efficiency, perceived fairness, and decision quality.
• Create in-product education and policy guidance that helps users understand community standards and safe behavior.
• Improve consistency and clarity across notices, enforcement surfaces, appeal entry points, and report-status feedback.
• Partner with Engineering, Design, Policy, Operations, and Data to turn complex governance rules into scalable user experiences.
• Use feedback, behavioral data, and governance metrics to continuously test and improve trust outcomes.

Requirements:
• 3+ years of Product Management experience; consumer product, Trust & Safety, platform governance, or complex platform experience is preferred.
• Strong user empathy and the ability to explain complex rules through simple product experiences.
• Experience with appeals, reporting systems, notification centers, policy communication, or transparency products is preferred.
• Excellent cross-functional execution with Engineering, Design, Policy, and Operations.
• Strong data-driven product judgment and experimentation skills.
• Professional fluency in both Chinese and English is required.

Preferred:
User-trust or governance-transparency experience at a large internet platform; familiarity with Trust & Safety or content moderation; global internet or large-scale UGC product experience.

Location: Palo Alto, CA. US visa sponsorship is available.

岗位职责：

• Strong analytical judgment, operational execution, and the ability to drive closure under pressure and ambiguity.

Preferred:
Trust & Safety, risk operations, anti-abuse, or incident-response experience at a content platform; collaboration with Policy, Moderation, vendors, or global teams; safety-governance work in a large internet or UGC ecosystem.

加入全球内容社区平台 Trust & Safety 政策团队，制定和优化面向国际市场的内容与社区政策，保障平台安全、合规与生态健康。团队 HC 充足，覆盖政策专家及部分政策方向 POC（Policy Owner / Point of Contact）需求，可根据候选人的专长匹配 Fraud、儿童安全、色情治理或综合内容政策等方向。

岗位职责：
• 制定、维护并持续优化全球内容与社区政策，包括社区准则、广告政策、创作者政策及重点风险专项政策。
• 将政策原则转化为清晰、可执行的审核标准、处置规则和运营指引，支持审核团队稳定执行。
• 与审核、法务、产品、工程、运营及数据团队协作，确保政策理解一致并完成系统与流程落地。
• 识别和评估新兴平台风险，结合执行数据、用户反馈、案例与行业趋势持续迭代政策。
• 参与跨境重大事件和复杂风险议题的分析与决策，平衡用户安全、表达、合规和产品生态。
• 对于 POC 级岗位，负责相应政策领域的框架设计、关键判断、跨团队协调和执行质量。

任职要求：
• 本科及以上学历，法律、公共政策、国际关系、传媒、社会学或相关专业优先。
• 4 年以上 Trust & Safety、内容政策、平台治理、金融欺诈政策或相关领域经验；有海外或跨国背景优先。
• 中英文均可作为工作语言，能够独立参与复杂政策讨论并完成中英文文档。
• 跨文化理解与沟通能力强，理解不同地区的用户行为、文化差异和政策风险。
• 能在快速变化、多时区的环境中作出高质量判断并推动落地。

重点方向画像：
• Fraud Policy：欢迎来自金融科技、数字支付、交易或互联网金融平台的欺诈政策及风险治理人才。
• 儿童安全 / 色情治理：优先考虑大型 UGC、社交、视频及内容平台的相关政策经验。
• 综合平台政策：大型全球科技、搜索、电商、社交及内容平台背景均可考虑。以上公司类型仅作经验参考，不代表定向挖猎。

descriptionEn:
Role Overview:
Join the Trust & Safety Policy organization of a global content-community platform and develop policies that support safety, compliance, and ecosystem health across international markets. The team has multiple openings, including specialist and policy POC/owner needs across areas such as Fraud, Child Safety, Sexual Content, and broader content policy.

Responsibilities:
• Develop, maintain, and improve global content and community policies, including community standards, ads policies, creator policies, and issue-specific risk frameworks.
• Translate policy principles into clear review standards, enforcement rules, and operational guidance for consistent moderation.
• Partner with Moderation, Legal, Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data to align policy interpretation and implementation.
• Identify emerging risks and improve policy through execution data, user feedback, case analysis, and industry trends.
• Support complex cross-border incidents and sensitive policy decisions, balancing user safety, expression, compliance, and ecosystem health.
• For POC-level openings, own the framework, critical decisions, cross-functional alignment, and execution quality for a policy domain.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or above; Law, Public Policy, International Relations, Communications, Sociology, or a related field is preferred.
• 4+ years in Trust & Safety, content policy, platform governance, financial-fraud policy, or a related field; international experience is preferred.
• Professional fluency in both Chinese and English is required, including complex discussions and written policy documentation.
• Strong cross-cultural judgment and understanding of regional user behavior, cultural context, and policy risk.
• Ability to make high-quality decisions and drive execution in a fast-moving, multi-time-zone environment.

Relevant Profiles:
• Fraud Policy: experience from fintech, digital payments, trading, or internet-finance platforms.
• Child Safety / Sexual Content: policy experience from large UGC, social, video, or content platforms is strongly preferred.
• General Platform Policy: backgrounds from large global technology, search, commerce, social, or content platforms are relevant. These company categories are examples only and do not represent directed sourcing.

Preferred:
Knowledge of GDPR, DSA, COPPA, or other international platform-governance and privacy regulations; experience with cross-border risks, global major events, or highly sensitive policy issues; prior policy-owner/POC or complex cross-functional leadership experience.

Locations: San Francisco Bay Area or Singapore. None of these four openings is based in New York. US visa sponsorship is available. Singapore candidates with PR or citizenship are preferred. Multiple headcount is available, including specialist and POC-level needs.
